notes.title: Ankama Show Time: Wakfu
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/f006aab179eaf9f10a9a1dcd797e01377abb0113.jpg[/img]

The replay is here, but you're already in the right place for a quick recap!

[previewyoutube=Cfm4iFkHiUM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Misty Isle Update[/h2]
Since the dawn of time, sailors have spoken of an unknown island that would sometimes appear on the horizon before disappearing behind an impenetrable fog. It's a very intriguing mystery. But nothing can prepare you for what awaits you on the Misty Isle! 

The first update of the year introduces this new island to Wakfu along with Nox, one of the series' iconic characters. But that's not all! To recap:

[b]A new island
6 dungeons
A new antagonist: Nox
Hundreds of new items
A level increase to level 245
Quests brimming with revelations
Maybe even a new…[/b]
We won't say too much because you'll learn more soon!
From today, get ready to explore five new areas populated with five new monster families. Uncover secrets about the island's history and expect plenty of surprises!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/41db22a50c1e87a93c060bc025c1ef41499c2cc0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/bd8f99cb656c6638c0a20382084ca9faf668fd22.png[/img]

[h2]Bestiale: Return to Osamosa![/h2]

The new anime Bestiale is the perfect opportunity for Wakfu to include new transmedia elements. First of all, a new quest related to the anime will be added to the game. You'll meet various characters from the series and follow a short story. This quest is a chance to return to the "Osamosa" dimension: Yes, the god Osamodas has set you a new challenge, and you'll get to pit yourself against some very, very tough dragons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/f2bd5170b41fac19fe87eb50e370ff43de0c88de.png[/img]

We can't wait to see you take on this new boss!

[h2]Interface Revamp[/h2]

For over a year, we have been doing some detailed studies on the game's interfaces so we can introduce improvements that best meet the expectations of players. We then had a year-long, major design phase to come up with a solid and clean foundation. Many system choices were proposed and discussed in addition to our work on the marketplace and purchase offers.

We shared our progress with the community throughout this study, and we'll continue to do so. Next year, we hope to move on to the next step: integrating more and more new interfaces directly into the game for a more seamless and accessible experience. The pace should pick up in the coming year!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/ad26aacf8f1d3e7c4747d627420fb93997411b4e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/44a68857a466856b6633590c0e708e4cb61e5fff.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/e54b5a89bbace1ea3be6645454cda83cfbe33024.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/3cf4e7140a9df7b46757f5330d8697fb1da6a22f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/0b89e5c02a463b83396c33acfed8811f58ab7b6d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/949b4cfd4427a0b07f3eff55e80fcc64877fbad9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/e3dcd8d30e4fcd38ab652816638c3a2771c82868.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/5be24f404bf89bbe7af7b6ca56ace3bfb937f0f0.png[/img]

[h2]Class Balancing[/h2]
This year, the teams will focus on a few revamps of iconic classes, with plans for the Iop, Sram and Pandawa classes.

Regarding the Iop class, we have already made progress with a gameplay idea that would retain the class's current identity while adding more possibilities. To start with, Gutting Gust and Uppercut would become 3rd-bar spells, and their element would change based on the last spell cast. The other big change would be to combos: Instead of requiring specific spells, they would require spells with an equivalent AP cost. This will mean completely changing some spells so that we have 1, 2 and 3 AP spells in each elemental path, and that also means creating two new air spells.

This is how the system could work:

Before:
Wallop (2 AP)
Flurry (1 AP)
Gutting Gust (1 MP)
Now:
Celestial Sword / Shaker / Wallop (2 AP)
Sword of Judgment / Charge (adjacent) / Flurry (1 AP)
Gutting Gust (1 MP)
Lastly, some new combos might be added.

[h2]Back to Early Promises[/h2]
Bestiale is a series that includes very strong themes around nature. This is fitting because the themes of flora and fauna play a central role in our vision for the year!

We're looking to update and fine-tune the systems that make Wakfu unique:

[b]Ecology
Politics
PvP[/b]
The teams have always been driven by unique concepts conveyed by the project's original vision. It was a vision of a living world, a world in motion. It was a vision of a world where players can meet each other and experience new adventures every day. This vision has never faded and has been maintained within the team.

Every year, we discussed placing more importance on ecosystems. Every year, we discussed developing deeper political features. Every year, we wanted to find an interesting and unique PvP formula. But every year, we had other priorities. The fact is, these features can't live up to their potential if the foundations of the game are too unstable.

In recent years, we have worked hard to make Wakfu more accessible and more stable. We are quite happy with the game's current state, but we now want to give it features that live up to its ambitions. We're convinced that this is necessary and key for the future of the project and that it will restore Wakfu to its rightful place in the MMORPG ecosystem.

We are therefore going "back to early promises". We don't want to copy and paste our old ideas but rather take our old spirit and vision and adapt them to what the game is today. It will be a long and challenging journey, but we want to go on this journey with you.

This work will start in 2025 but won't be finished next year. We want to proceed like we normally do: area by area. With this iterative approach, we can work closely with our community. There will also be a cost: We won't be able to develop lots of new content like we normally do. The next big expansion after Misty Isle won't be in 2025, although a few new challenges will be added in future updates, as you'll have guessed.

[h2]What Now?[/h2]
2025 will see lots of new content and improvements for the World of Twelve. Which announcement are you most excited about? Let us know in the comments, and get ready for another year to remember!

See you in 2025!

notes.title: Anti-Bot Efforts: Changes to the Kama Stone Service
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/0350ff9432b23236192b8ff50b60faf13a96249e.jpg[/img]
[h2]New Restrictions on Turning Kamas into Ogrines[/h2]
Along the same lines as [b][url=https://www.dofus.com/en/mmorpg/news/devblog/tickets/1751667-kama-exchange-changing-fight-bots]the recent change made by our DOFUS colleagues[/url],[/b] we've decided to [b]limit the purchase of [url=www.wakfu.com/en/kamas]Kama Stones[/url] using kamas[/b] (to get ogrines); [b]allowing it only for accounts created before January 1, 2023, or accounts that have made at least one purchase in real currency (€, $, etc.) since their creation.[/b] This restriction goes into effect on November 26, the date this article is published.

In summary:
[list]	[*]If your account was created before January 1, 2023, you can still get ogrines using kamas without spending money. [/*]	[*]If you have a more recent account, the account will have unlimited ability to purchase Kama Stones to access the various elements in the WAKFU shop after you've made a real currency purchase without needing to spend more money for cosmetics, Boosters, etc. [/*][/list]This measure is intended to anticipate and counter an influx of bots from DOFUS, attempting to subscribe with ogrines by generating them on WAKFU. This will not only support the actions already taken on DOFUS, but also counter some of the issues exploited by bot networks and the sale of kamas.

Extensive analysis indicates that this change will have a major impact on these undesirable behaviors, greatly improving everyone's comfort in the game and the economic health on our servers.

[h2]Linking Ogrines and Items from the WAKFU Shop[/h2]
The second change impacting the service is our decision to [b]link ogrines obtained via the purchase of Kama Stones[/b] and [b]link all WAKFU shop items[/b] (consumables, costumes, adventurer boxes, Sadida bags) regardless of the currency used (linked or unlinked ogrines / real currency).

Please note that [b]these changes are not retroactive;[/b] ogrines already obtained as well as any previous purchases will not be changed.

[b][u]As a reminder,[/u][/b] ogrines are linked if they come from the DOFUS Kama Exchange, the Steam shop and now the Kama Stone service.

The lack of a link enabled multiple actions that had a negative impact on the game by destabilizing its economy. For example, it was possible to unlink ogrines from the DOFUS Kama Exchange via WAKFU, to transfer kamas from one DOFUS server to another.

We also discovered that illegal networks were generating kamas on WAKFU, then transforming them into DOFUS kamas to resell them.

We understand that some players may prefer the previous functionality, but this decision will prevent many behaviors from harming the game. We believe this is the best solution for the long term.

[b]These measures also pave the way for the potential reactivation of purchasing Kamas Stones with real currency on Steam in a future update.[/b]

notes.title: Summary of the Livestream on November 6, 2024: End-of-Year Update Pushed Back
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/dd44cd88de463e330ed1243a031645fec26edb67.png[/img]
[h2]Update 1.86 Report[/h2]

The 1.86 Update will let you explore a new island in the World of Twelve and meet Nox, the antagonist from the WAKFU series. This update was originally announced for the end of 2024 in the KrosmoNote and at the Ankama Convention. However, we've decided to postpone the update until the beginning next year.

Despite the considerable amount of work and effort by our teams, we came up against a number of issues in the production phase that led us to postpone this content expansion. We're sorry we haven't been able to keep our promise. We would nevertheless like to emphasize that we are moving this update in part to be sure we deliver a finished, bold product with this very special island. New dungeons, new quests, and exciting encounters will be waiting for you at the beginning of next year and we can't wait to tell you all about it!

[h2]Interfaces[/h2]

In addition to the new expansion, the 1.86 update will include game interface improvements.

The community has long been requesting upgraded interfaces and we took that request seriously this year. After extensive preparations, we're happy to have launched a new, complete, and accessible Marketplace on WAKFU. We had the chance to develop this project with the community and we want to thank you again for having given your feedback so we could refine the interface's user experience.

Even though the polls about proposed visual style of the new interfaces were very positive, we decided to work on a new, more artistic proposal with the help of our partner, Figs. The Marketplace's current theme is great and has an interesting simplicity, but we wanted to take it a step further. We want to give you a more striking visual style with a strong identity that represents the game. Figs was inspired to suggest a return to the stone that is so emblematic of WAKFU with its frescoes, its physicality, and its blue energy.

Here are some before-and-after comparisons (these models are not representative of the final in-game interfaces):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/db9f60d9854f3c3535727fa619c8050d3f611efb.png[/img]
We've approved this new direction, which we feel is better and more personal, so we're going to change the in-game rendering and modify the theme.

We're also planning to revisit the entire build system in order to simplify it and make it more effective. We've been iterating the system since the last time we presented this interface and here's our current progress (again, this is just a mockup):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/d08c6fefd92c05e524e05bc0818407f085823142.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/ed86b9d72866ccd57500e81743a6eddbe3caee0e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/949256f640183e55d6936869012a56e17e621f4e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/070a766d8ae943cb07874e539d5173e46502239e.png[/img]
And finally, here's the quest book. For now, the interface isn't nearly as advanced and won't be included in 1.86, but we wanted to show you what we're putting together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/adb4a299041d2dd4ad13eaeed9808d767605e3cb.png[/img]
[h2]Play Time[/h2]

We know play time has been an important topic in the community for a while and we've decided to make several changes. Some will be available soon, others will arrive in the months and years to come.

Approved for November:
[list][*]Increased playing time at start of turn based on the character's resources
[*]Half a second for each AP / MP
[*]No dynamic increase in the event of AP / MP gain or loss during the turn
[*]The issue with delayed seconds linked to the velocity bonus has been fixed[/list]
Under Study:
[list][*]Added fast dashes on all classes (when moving more than four cells)
[*]Pre-calculation of movements (ability to cast spells from the next destination cell, before a movement or a movement spell has occurred)
[*]Faster animations on certain spells for certain classes
[*]Longer play time for certain types of combats[/list]
The whole team wants to thank you for your patience, your feedback, and your investment and we hope to see you soon to discuss the next part of this project more.

If you'd like to watch the recording of this stream, it's available now on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/ankamalive][b]our Twitch channel[/b][/url]!

notes.title: Ankama Convention Announcements Rundown
notes.notes:
The WAKFU team took advantage of the Ankama Convention to give everybody an update about the project during a special Ankama Live. This article summarizes all the news and announcements for WAKFU!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/da23311d660c779598eb9d6460004ac10fe1fdfe.jpg[/img]
[h1]Looking Back[/h1]

The first part of the past year has been chock-full of new features for WAKFU, so we've taken the opportunity to give you a quick rundown of the content added in our last three updates.

[h2]Update 1.82 - Wabbit Island[/h2]

[previewyoutube=ytYd9zkdA9Q;full][/previewyoutube]
At the end of 2023, we completely overhauled [b]the famous Wabbit Island[/b]with new families of monsters, redesigned zones, a new storyline, dozens of new pieces of equipment and more. This overhaul enabled us to address a number of issues that the team had identified, particularly the difficulties players were experiencing with the content in the 125-140 and 141-155 level ranges; it also let us artistically freshen up an island that was becoming dated.

To find out more, take a look at [url=www.youtube.com/watch?v=qtILZ6a3Bec&ab_channel=WAKFUOfficial][b]our "Backstage" video[/b][/url] and [url=www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/devblog/tickets/1665929-devblog-wabbit-island][b]our devblog[/b][/url]!

[h2]Update 1.83 - Tal Kasha[/h2]

[previewyoutube=qXZSERg_DEY;full][/previewyoutube]
Our March update introduced a new Ultimate Boss – Tal Kasha. Players were invited to take on a sizeable challenge and storm the Queen of the Cursed's pyramid. Continuing on from the Wabbit Island rework, we also added the conclusions to previously introduced quests and the infamous Ivory Dofus.

Meanwhile, Sadidas were overhauled to make dolls more central to their gameplay again, and to make them more fun and dynamic!

We also took advantage of this update to make some Quality of Life improvements, especially regarding how secure crafting and gratuities work.

[h2]Update 1.84 - Necroworld[/h2]

[previewyoutube=qctkYhrGf5Q;full][/previewyoutube]
The most recent update to date was the "[url=www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/announcements/1721732-necroworld-interview][b]Necroworld[/b][/url]", a 3-player dungeon added to WAKFU at the beginning of July, with its boss, Toross Mordal!

And he wasn't alone: he brought Necromic Steles along with him. The changes to steles meant we could make a lot of the level ranges more attractive and worthwhile by introducing a new reward system. You can find all the details about this in our [url=www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/devblog/tickets/1707789-devblog-development-steles][b]devblog on the subject[/b][/url].

As we announced during the [url=www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/announcements/1681158-krosmonote-recap][b]KrosmoNote[/b][/url] and in [url=www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/announcements/1675686-2024-with-you][b]our 2024 new year's message[/b][/url], the interface overhaul project was also launched with a makeover for [url=www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/devblog/tickets/1712244-devblog-new-marketplace][b]Marketplaces[/b][/url]. More user-friendly, better performing, and more attractive, the new Marketplaces are a very encouraging first step toward the interfaces we'll be updating in the future.

[h1]Looking Ahead: Update 1.85[/h1]

Update 1.85 was revealed a few days ago; here's a recap of what you'll be seeing in game soon.

[h2]A New Decoration System and Changes to the Trool Fair[/h2]

As we announced in [url=www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/devblog/tickets/1733126-devblog-account-entity-decorations?refreshcache][b]our recent devblog[/b][/url], the Trool Fair will undergo a few changes to tie in with the DOFUS 20th anniversary celebration. You'll also be able to try out new attractions that will test your memory to the max.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/b21dc08399b028822adc02e693ccdfdbc8445a32.gif[/img]

These changes are an opportunity for us to add in some handy new rewards to go along with a brand-new haven bag decoration system.

These will now be able to be consumed to link to both the account and server, just like costumes. Players will then be able to put learned decorations in their characters' haven bags (and haven worlds) as many times as they like! It's a big step forward to let your creativity flow and open up housing customization options.

[h2]Enutrof Revamp[/h2]

The long-awaited revamp of the Enutrof class is now available to be tested in the Beta. We've introduced several major changes to make gameplay more deep and varied:
[list][*]The deposit system has been freshened up, with new features and a fourth new sapphire deposit. You can still use them to remove resistances, but they can now also grant bonuses.[/*][*]The Drhellzerker state gets more powerful with every turn an Enutrof remains in this form, and the range you had before using the transformation is offset by a bonus that gives you greater build flexibility for this class.[/*][*]Spells and passives have been reworked and rebalanced to diversify the gameplay. There are more support and damage options to discover.[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/3528311205c5cc9aa71c515bcb5bfef8716b6db4.png[/img]
Enutrofs are also getting a makeover, with a brand-new look and new alternative animations in which they can fight with their shovels (which will be available in a later update). Here's a [b]work-in-progress[/b] preview:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/4b70b4eb42e1f9a54b7266c858f48d356533a4dd.gif[/img]
[h1]The Interface Revamp[/h1]

One of the biggest subjects on the WAKFU news front is the interface revamp we mentioned earlier. These changes are going to be implemented gradually, so we'd like to give you a few details of what to expect.

[b]Please note that the images shared below show work-in-progress interfaces or mock-ups, some of which were already presented during the last KrosmoNote.[/b]

[h2]Purchase Offers Arriving in 1.85[/h2]

Purchase offers, presented during the KrosmoNote at the start of the year, can also be tested in the Beta. This system complements the initial changes to Marketplaces in July, making trading easier and introducing a fresh approach to managing the game's economy.

You'll be able to issue and reply to bids for fast, precise transactions: see all the details in [url=www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/devblog/tickets/1732875-devblog-purchase-offers][b]our devblog about this[/b][/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/0b674010f531e2230522efeb05172753061d45d5.png[/img]
[h2]Adjustments[/h2]

Adjustments are a particularly complex system that can sometimes be hard to control. That's why we're planning to make the interface more intuitive and practical, notably by reducing the time it can take to create a build. We're also adding an overall view to allow you to easily compare statistics between builds.

Faster, simple, easier to read: this is what we're committed to doing with the interfaces in terms of adjustments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/230e9d4a65e1d7668a4cc0496c83b49616e64254.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/f24942e4e33e893944cebd3f4d5ffaa69fef3316.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/448238f3982b26bbabd26bd7f5f9c6602d3bf81a.png[/img]
[h2]The HUD[/h2]

The HUD (heads up display) is being improved to offer a wider angle from a higher point of view. Its overall appearance is also more modern, in line with the latest interfaces, which have already been reworked. In combat, the whole timeline no longer moves when a fighter takes their turn. Now, the timeline remains still, and the cursor moves toward the different fighters throughout the turn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/011c774f68dea6b15cba0e04f04b75ba9782bd2c.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/a68823e22cbea2c9b840bca14c41ab92a737ac85.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/a1e8e26ac5325f2ec79f8dda10122f1fb8eff07d.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/a6bc0f71bea0c6d3378ae5ffd82cc83f22624c1e.png[/img]
[h2]What's Next?[/h2]

We also want to separate the cosmetics inventory from the character inventory and add new features, such as the ability to save and apply cosmetic sets. This will increase the overall customization options for everyone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/e1e063ffca7480fed9a6e52772a3d29f9b1087f0.png[/img]
[h1]Late 2024: Update 1.86[/h1]

What better way to introduce our next big expansion than with a new teaser? Sit back and enjoy the show:

[previewyoutube=0cqoiQAs7EE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]New Expansion[/h2]

A brand-new area will appear at the end of year in the World of Twelve. This mysterious island harbors many secrets that players will have to unravel by exploring a variety of biomes, while keeping an eye out for the five new families of monsters inhabiting them.

This expansion will also raise the level cap; it is destined for players at levels 231-245. It's the perfect opportunity to expand the game with a whole new level band to discover and master.

[h2]Noximilian the Clockmaker[/h2]

Probably one of the most famous antagonists in the Krosmoz, Noximilian the Clockmaker has taken up residence on this misty island to extract as much Wakfu from it as possible. Only the boldest adventurers will have what it takes to confront the dreaded Xelor in what promises to be an epic battle!

[h1]WAKFU HD[/h1]

In late October 2023, we deployed a new client to display WAKFU's interactive elements in high definition: [url=www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/announcements/1649437-rediscover-wakfu-high-def][b]WAKFU HD[/b][/url].

As promised, after months of hard work, the environments* will be updated to WAKFU HD in the upcoming Update 1.85!

[i]*With the exception of the animated pictograms, which will arrive at a later date.[/i]

Are you ready to rediscover WAKFU in high definition?

notes.title: 2024 with You!
notes.notes:
The WAKFU MMO team wishes you a happy, healthy, and successful 2024. Siu wanted to take a look back at the past year as well as talk about the year to come, so here's a quick message from him to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/6b87e73764173a1eb24a59eb3eac7e5031c2d304.png[/img]​[h2]Recapping the Past Year[/h2]2023 marked a real turning point in the history of the WAKFU MMO, with the opening of five Ogrest single-account servers. The single-account servers have been a huge success and clearly shown an incredible enthusiasm for the game. Plus, our playership is higher than at the game's launch over 10 years ago! It's the most successful the project has ever been. This adventure would've been impossible without you, so thank you truly.

That wasn't the only area of development in 2023. Last year gave us a chance to [b]rework a number of classes:[/b][list][*]Cra[*]Huppermage[*]Eliotrope[*]Foggernaut[*]Xelor[*]Sacrier[*]Ecaflip[*]Eniripsa[*]Rogue[/list]These nine classes have enjoyed higher satisfaction rates since the revamp; rates that we collected and compared through multiple surveys completed by players. It's a success, and we're glad we could update these classes' mechanics in a fresh way. Nevertheless, we're aware that some of them would still benefit from being adjusted and expanded. Class balancing is a process that must continually be perfected. We'll never reach a point where we're fully satisfied, and now we want to spend more time on other areas.

For the past few years, we've been applying a different method: instead of iterating on a class's mechanics very quickly, basically in the moment, we give ourselves several months to track things and we avoid making any rash decisions. We want to allow for new mechanics to settle in over time. We can take stock of a class much more clearly and completely after a period of 3 to 6 months.

In 2023, we pursued our goal of renewing and improving [b]the quality of the game:[/b][list][*]a revamp of the early game, with an improved tutorial and additional guides[*]the end of the account entity, e.g., having professions and progress (artifacts, transportation, etc.) shared across the account and server-wide[*]WAKFU HD[*]removal of single-target and area masteries[/list]Some of these were substantial projects, but the outcome was worth it! We've advanced toward our vision of a more accessible, less obtuse WAKFU, while preserving its great richness. It wasn't all simple, but we believe we did our best to complete our objectives. Transitioning the game to HD, for example, was quite complicated, and we worked hard to offer more enjoyable gameplay and fulfill this recurring request from the community. We really look forward to the environments being in HD as well!

Other elements from last year that we're very proud of: minor changes for the sake of convenience, additional customization options for classes, a graphically tweaked Astrub, additional animations, typefaces in HD, and of course, the revamped Wabbit Island.

[h2]Sailing into 2024[/h2]We want to continue improving the game's existing content while offering new experiences. Here's what we're planning:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/683d5d327816510b013fcf5a887969a9a5fd194c.jpg[/img]
The 2024 roadmap for the WAKFU MMO will be detailed in the KrosmoNote. More details on this event will come next week.[list][*][b]Ultimate Boss Tal Kasha, the Ivory Dofus, and the end of the Wabbit quest[/b][list][*]These content items will be included in Update 1.83. There's many more twists for you to discover on Wabbit Island![/list][*][b]Balancing: Sadidas and Enutrofs[/b][list][*]These two classes are a priority for us, and we're planning to share more about Sadidas very soon.[/list][*][b]HD Environments[/b][list][*]We're continuing to work on the environments so that they're razor-sharp as well.[/list][*][b]Development of Steles[/b][list][*]Steles are an important component of dungeons in the WAKFU MMO. As of right now, we haven't established details for everything we plan to do with steles. We're looking into a number of different ways to potentially make steles more appealing and impactful. The goal is also for them to work more simply, more consistently, and for them to be more equally distributed in the game. We're very excited to tell you more about it![/list][*][b]Development of Interfaces[/b][list][*]We know that the WAKFU MMO interface could be greatly improved. This is one of the points most commonly raised by the community, who have long been wanting us to really focus on this topic.
We're preparing an ambitious, extensive project to revamp the interfaces. The goal is to modernize the interfaces, make them more user-friendly, and significantly improve the gaming experience for players.[*]That being said, this project will take several years of development. There's a great deal of aspects that require detailed, meticulous work. Each interface requires specific work, and we can't revolutionize everything at once. We'll take time to polish each one at a time.[/list][*][b]New Expansion[/b][list][*]We're preparing a content expansion that will come out at the end of the year as usual.
And this expansion will be special on multiple levels… We're so excited to show you what it'll look like. It will be one of the most memorable in the game's history![/list][/list][h2]Thank You[/h2]The WAKFU MMO is a unique and special adventure for all of us. We're lucky enough to have a small team of passionate, talented staff. We've been doing everything we can to enhance the project for years now, and on a personal note, I want to sincerely thank them.

Our community remains an infinite source of motivation. Your patience, your attentiveness, your will, your sense of sharing is a real boon to us. WAKFU's success is yours, first and foremost. Thank you for everything. Have an amazing 2024, and take care of yourselves; best wishes for your health, happiness, and success!

The WAKFU team

notes.title: Krosfighter: The Party Game that Blurs Borders
notes.notes:
Ankama Games and Doryah Games have come together for the first time and the result is nothing short of fun-tastic! Introducing [i]Krosfighter[/i], the party shooter that promises to deliver more wild fun than you know what to do with!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/2b5e352c84b55aed487c64d2602faa8846fd4ae9.png[/img]
How would you like to see the Visitor from the Future, Sherlock, Seth and even Yugo [b]all together in the same game?[/b] That's exactly the crazy fun you'll see in [i]Krosfighter[/i]! Initiated by Doryah Games and designed in collaboration with Ankama Games, this game – unique in Ankama's history – [b]blurs the borders between the universe of DOFUS,[/b] [b]WAKFU[/b] and [b]WAVEN[/b] and those of [b]Ankama Éditions[/b].[b] [/b]

Play as [b]legendary heroes[/b] from the greatest made-in-Ankama creations and have them fight each other in a game combining [b]fast action, fighting[/b] and [b]fun![/b] You don't need to be an experienced player! notes.title: Rediscover WAKFU… in High Def!
notes.notes:
As some of you have noticed, whether through our new guide interface or from images in the trailer for our upcoming single-account server, WAKFU in HD is now a reality!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/4def344c42006c977bc4b193e00153b487fb7cd3.jpg[/img]
It's a recurring request from the community, and for a while now we've been wanting to [b]upgrade the graphics in WAKFU.[/b] As you can imagine, this is a time-consuming project that we've been working on for a while already; we had to reexport every single graphical element in the game (characters, mobs, interactive elements, etc.).

Currently, [b]HD[/b] [b]mode is incomplete.[/b] We're nowhere near done improving the game environments*. Originally we wanted to wait and reveal the finished product. That said, in light of your excitement when the WAKFU single-account trailer came out, we've decided to release a [b]starting HD pack[/b] with the following animated elements: [list][*]characters[*]monsters[*]equipment[*]resources[*]interactive elements[*]pets and mounts[/list]* [i]Environments will be added in a future update.[/i]

With regard to interfaces, we hear your feedback and are aware of the issues raised. Improvements to interfaces will not be included in this HD pack; it's an area we're working on bit by bit, as this project can't be properly completed in one go.

Since images are better than a thousand words:
[previewyoutube=fYO9GPImXvs;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]HOW DO YOU ENABLE WAKFU HD?[/h2]HD mode is enabled by default!

This generated a bug ticket that makes us crack up internally, because after forcing the NPC to export in SD and when developing WAKFU HD, the NPC in question was then the only NPC to not appear in HD. notes.notes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/074479f93a1d47922fddb616f825911719b577e1.jpg[/img]

[h2]PRE-REGISTRATION & REWARDS[/h2]
Pre-register by [b]October 22[/b] (11:59 p.m. Paris time), and you'll get [b]2[/b] free [b]regeneration potions[/b] when the server goes live.[b]The more players pre-register, the more gifts you'll score when the Ogrest server opens.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/df8e51c8c8884b328af6b8099931963dc07113c7.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=wvsAOTchjqY;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]THE OGREST SERVER OPENS ON NOVEMBER 2, 2023[/b][/h2]

Are you up for a Mount-Zinit-level challenge?

[h2][b][url=https://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/monoaccount/register]REGISTER NOW![/url][/b][/h2]

[h1]Ogrest Single-Account Packs: Get Early Access![/h1]

The World of Twelve is about to be turned upside down once more. Who's to blame now? It's [b]Ogrest,[/b] yet again! But you don't have to worry about a big flood or wave. Then again… Maybe you do, actually – a wave of delight! The one you'll get when the [b]new single-account server launches![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/e78c0d06d3aa61ca12263afc1693d707763c11d4.jpg[/img]
To accompany this major addition to the WAKFU game, we're releasing [b]4 packs[/b] that all our players will love. Find something for you in one of the packs! These are:

[h2]ADVENTURER PACK[/h2]
Adventure is totally your thing. You go on adventures all day long. You think, sleep, eat, and breathe adven– Yeah, anyway, this pack is for you. It contains:[list][*]a Unique New Age costume (chameleon)[*]the "Sit on a throne" emote (linked to account)[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/aa6598bcc6ae82fa23b61a3ec306068324330a82.png[/img]
[h2]HERO PACK[/h2]
Would others describe you as bold, smart, agile, and brave? Look no further – this pack is clearly meant for you. It contains:[list][*]a Unique New Age costume (chameleon)[*]a Unique New Age pet skin (chameleon and linked to account)[*]the "Sit on a throne" emote (linked to account)[*]a token for a 30-day booster*[*]a White Sadida Bag[*][b]plus a free 48-hour early-access pass![/b][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/5004c884230b892516467b9c2b743176ff7950af.png[/img]
[h2]ELITE PACK[/h2]
There's the cream of the crop, and there's the cherry on top. When it comes to adventure, you're the cherry on top of the cream of the crop. Yes, you read that right. This pack contains:[list][*]a Unique New Age costume (chameleon)[*]a Unique New Age pet skin (chameleon and linked to account)[*]a Unique New Age mount skin (chameleon and linked to account)[*]an exclusive mythical title: Builder[*]a token for a 90-day booster*[*]the "Sit on a throne" emote (linked to account)[*]a White Sadida Bag[*]a Haven Bag chest tab[*]13,000 Ogrines[*]an Adventurer Box[*][b]plus a free 48-hour early-access pass![/b][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/50a3790e228fb890452fba5094741b15527c0659.png[/img]
[h2]LEGENDARY PACK[/h2]
Oh, you're not the stuff of legend yet? All you had to do was ask. This pack contains:[list][*]a Unique New Age costume (chameleon)[*]a Guild New Age costume (chameleon)[*]a Unique New Age pet skin (chameleon and linked to account)[*]a Guild New Age pet skin (chameleon and linked to account)[*]a Unique New Age mount skin (chameleon and linked to account)[*]a Guild New Age mount skin (chameleon and linked to account)[*]an exclusive mythical title: Builder[*]an exclusive legendary title: Pioneer of the New Age[*]a token for a 180-day booster*[*]the "Sit on a throne" emote (linked to account)[*]2 White Sadida Bags[*]3 Haven Bag chest tabs[*]28,000 Ogrines[*]an Adventurer Box[*]a Slippery Run (linked to account)[*]Super Growth Kibble[*][b]plus a free 48-hour early-access pass![/b][/list]
[i]*The booster is the same[b] [/b]for all three servers. However, it will have a different effect on the single-account server.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/235e570c21247f947c4b8acdeedb00138f3e245f.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/a03af6d707dd4896407f3476a6178578155ec091.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/09a6664f9dff1cbffc20d7bdc399f31f8398cc11.png[/img]

You'll notice that three of these packs contain a [b]48-hour early-access pass.[/b] What is this sorcery, you ask? The pass will grant [b]access to the single-account server 2 days before its official launch,[/b] i.e. [b]Tuesday, October 31[/b] instead of [b]Thursday, November 2.[/b]

It's our way of thanking you for supporting the event when you got a pre-registration pack!

[h1]Single-Account FAQ: Your Questions Answered[/h1]

This FAQ (frequently asked questions) page is designed to present and compile, in a very clear way, the ins and outs of the single-account server known as Ogrest. It may be added to over the next few days. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/68baf135a82f422458a5799f2afec8d622b41362.jpg[/img][h3]WHAT IS OGREST?[/h3][list][*]Ogrest is an [b]international,[/b] [b]single-character[/b] and [b]single-account server,[/b] where [b]heroes[/b] and [b]sidekicks[/b] are completely [b]deactivated.[/b][*]There are [b]5 character slots[/b] per server – a cap that can be increased up to 18 with the character slot addition service (if you purchased this service before coming to this server, the extra slots will be automatically included).[/list][h3]WHO CAN ACCESS IT?[/h3]The server is only accessible to players with:[list][*][b]a verified account[/b][*][b]a valid phone number[/b][*][b]a valid email address[/b][/list]Two accounts can log in from the same IP address [b]only if:[/b][list][*]the accounts have a confirmed address;[*]they have different confirmed email addresses;[*]they are logged in on different devices;[*]and they have different phone numbers.[/list][h3]HOW DOES PRE-REGISTRATION WORK?[/h3]The pre-registration period runs from [b]October 5[/b] (5 p.m. Paris time) to [b]October 22[/b] (11:59 p.m.). When pre-registering, you have to include your character's [b]gender,[/b] [b]class,[/b] and [b]nickname.[/b]

[b]Important information:[/b][list][*]Class can be changed as much as you want [b]up to level 30.[/b][*]The character's gender can be (re)set during customization.[/list]Pre-registered players get [b]2[/b] [b]free[/b] [b]regeneration potions[/b] when the server opens. Another important point: Pre-registration numbers will translate to [b]stretch[/b] [b][i]goals.[/i][/b]

[h3]What's a [i]stretch goal?[/i][/h3]
This is a tier of pre-registered players to reach in order to unlock prizes. [b]The more of you pre-register, the more free rewards you'll get when the server opens![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/df8e51c8c8884b328af6b8099931963dc07113c7.jpg[/img][h3]WHAT ABOUT THE SINGLE-ACCOUNT PACKS?[/h3]Four packs of varying contents and prices have been designed to meet all players' needs. [b]A pass offering 2-day early access[/b] is included starting with the second pack.

Note that you don't need a pack in order to pre-register.

[h3]EARLY ACCESS?[/h3]
Players who purchase pack 1, 2, 3, or 4 will gain access to the single-account server on [b]October 31.[/b] For everyone else, the server will become accessible on [b]November 2[/b] (4 p.m. Paris time).

The early-access mechanic will also allow our team to [b]manage the influx of players[/b] and adjust the server load. Even with pre-registration, we think it's worth being extra cautious with server capacity. A 2-day early access period will therefore be beneficial in breaking up the arrival of players.

Also, since WAKFU is a free-to-play game, these packs and the early-access period will help give us a return on our team's investment in this project.

[h3]WILL THE BOOSTER VARY?[/h3]
The Booster is the [b]same[/b] for all three servers. However, it will have a different effect on the single-account server.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/abcc374a06a7c5ead8df3c3ef8e7f2b8a810abb8.png[/img][h3]WHAT WILL HAPPEN TO GIFTS AND OTHER ITEMS OBTAINED FROM THE SHOP BEFORE THE START OF PRE-REGISTRATION FOR THE OGREST SERVER?[/h3]
Items purchased from the shop and other gifts and compensation obtained [b]prior to pre-registration[/b] for the Ogrest server [b]won't be recoverable[/b] on the Ogrest server.

[b]Experience potions,[/b] [b]loot potions,[/b] and [b]harvest potions[/b] obtained after the start of pre-registration[b] [/b]won't be recoverable when the Ogrest server launches. You'll be able to retrieve them [b]beginning December 2.[/b]

[h3]IS THE ACCOUNT ENTITY THE SAME?[/h3]
The following [b]will be retained[/b] within [b]Pandora,[/b] [b]Rubilax,[/b] and [b]Ogrest:[/b][list][*]number of character slots (not including slots from fusion)[*]number of Haven Bag chest slots[*]number of ability, spell, and equipment pages[/list]The following [b]won't be retained[/b] within [b]Pandora,[/b] [b]Rubilax,[/b] and [b]Ogrest:[/b][list][*]cosmetics[*]titles[*]emotes[*]profession levels[*]progress[*]kamas, items, etc.[/list][h3]WHAT ELSE?[/h3]
[b]Community events[/b] will coincide with pre-registration and the single-account server launch (rush achievements, contests on social media, sessions with content creators, etc.); we'll have more details soon!

[previewyoutube=wvsAOTchjqY;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]THE OGREST SERVER OPENS ON NOVEMBER 2, 2023[/b][/h2]

Are you up for a Mount-Zinit-level challenge?

[h2][b][url=https://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/monoaccount/register]REGISTER NOW![/url][/b][/h2]

Until October 22 (11:59 p.m. Paris time)

notes.title: Now Arriving at Ereboria: The Cursed Island!

After days of sailing in search of the gloomy isle… "Land ho!" With your eye glued to a spyglass, you finally spot it: the cursed island of Ereboria. Update 1.78 is in the game and waiting for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/c4b6d9c2494c908e3fea1786d9c4e795f76c90f8.jpg[/img]

The journey's been long, but you're in for a thrill.

[b]Five new zones, five dungeons, five quests, five monster families,[/b] and a plethora of [b]new equipment and sublimations[/b] await you on the cursed island! In Ereboria, there's something for everyone, and at every level:
[list]	[*]The [b]Pirate Beach[/b] for level 36-50 buccaneers welcomes you to a lush tropical land. It's so pretty! But don't let your guard down…[/*]	[*]The [b]Cursed Beach[/b] for level 36-50 brawlers shows its colors (or the lack thereof). You won't find any lounge chairs here! Just a splash of terror.[/*]	[*]The [b]Bitter-Hammer Caverns[/b] for level 51-65 adventurers will make anyone feel claustrophobic. But that'll be the least of your problems![/*]	[*]The [b]Ocean Prison[/b] for level 216-230 seasoned fighters will engulf you in dread…[/*]	[*]The [b]New Sufokian Mine[/b] for level 216-230 brave souls will unveil the horrors brewing in the bowels of Ereboria…[/*][/list]

[b]The main quest,[/b] with its surprise twists and interesting details, should captivate you. It's bound to reveal the many mysteries on this island!

Did you think that'd be it? You better watch your back: at any moment, if you activate the intervention steles, [b]Cire Momore[/b] might crash the party as an [b]intervention boss[/b] on any of the island's five levels, from the surface to the depths…

Finally, [b]Foggernauts[/b] are getting their 100,000-kilokameter check-up: the [b]class revamp[/b] will include a [b]new humanoid alternative body.[/b] Other surprises are in store if you dig around…

[url=https://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/patch-notes/1553629-ereboria-ile-maudite]DIG INTO THE UPDATE NOTES[/url]

notes.title: New Horizons – Adventure Awaits You in WAKFU!
notes.notes:
Set out to explore an array of new features with [b]WAKFU[/b] [b]Update 1.76,[/b] known as [b]New Horizons and now available for download![/b]

The World of Twelve is beginning a new chapter. How the story unfolds will depend on your heroic deeds…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/3b5b8dd2e964934a5dfae878c30609712b0151cf.png[/img]

Embark on [b]new adventures in WAKFU![/b] Along with your friends or heroes, this latest odyssey will take you through [b]all the dungeons in the game,[/b] which have (nearly) all changed! Who knows? Glory and riches may be attained from this new quest. Your fate lies in your own hands…

[h2][u]Dungeons Getting a New Format[/u][/h2] 
[b]Rediscover the dungeons and their unique mechanics in a new format.[/b] Historically featuring four rooms, dungeons will shift to two as they reach higher levels. While reconquering these dungeons, you'll find that some will only let you enter as a group of three characters instead of six.

[b]Push your limits by reaching Stasis levels*[/b][b] never reached before.[/b] The brackets are simpler, their difficulty is higher, and your journeys will be handsomely rewarded…

The new difficulty brackets are divided into 10 levels:
[list]	[*]Level 1 (previously Stasis level 1)[/*]	[*]Level 2 (previously Stasis level 11)[/*]	[*]Level 3 (previously Stasis level 21) and so on…[/*][/list]
And so forth, up to the highest bracket: level 10!

[b]Clinch the top spot in one of the competitive rankings and earn exclusive prizes.[/b] Reward chests are now based on Stasis level, and their contents have been updated. As you can get sublimations from a crafting recipe, these will now be more accessible, while Stasis shards have become less common. The competitive rankings will reward the bravest adventurers…

[url=https://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/devblog/tickets/1460789-devblog-dungeons-2]LEARN MORE ABOUT THE IMPROVEMENTS MADE TO DUNGEONS BY READING THE DEVBLOG![/url]
 
[h2][u]Cosmetics Inventory: Runs, Finishers, and Auras[/u][/h2]

[b]Share your various cosmetic items between all your heroes simultaneously. You'll gain even more space in your inventory.[/b] Once runs and finishers have been learned, these are shown in their tab in the cosmetics inventory.

[b]Display your favorite aura without being forced to wear the corresponding relic.[/b] Auras are now separate from relics and can be accessed from the cosmetics inventory. Once the corresponding achievement is completed, your aura can be used with any equipment…
 
[url=https://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/devblog/tickets/1459502-devblog-account-entity-cosmetics-inventory-part-2]FOLLOW OUR PROGRESS WITH THE ACCOUNT ENTITY AND COSMETICS INVENTORY BY READING THE DEVBLOG![/url]
 
[h2][u]Build Pages Getting Bigger[/u][/h2]

[b]Vary your combat style by quickly switching between build pages.[/b] The first 15 Spells, Equipment, and Characteristics pages are free, and you can now have up to 25 pages for even greater flexibility…
 
[url=https://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/announcements/1472926-more-free-build-pages-added?refreshcache]DETAILS CAN BE FOUND IN THIS SPECIAL ANNOUNCEMENT![/url]
 
[h2][u]Event: Boss Smasher – Ultimate[/u][/h2]

[b]The first four Ultimate Bosses of WAKFU are waiting for you once more. And they've got a few surprises for you![/b]
Excarnus, Magmog, Milkar, and the Black Crow are ready to rumble (again): to all you brave adventurers in a regular group, herd your party members and embark on a race to achieve the utmost feats, facing four bosses who've reinvented themselves…
 
[url=https://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/announcements/1471375-ultimate-boss-smasher-get-back-into]WANT TO JOIN THE FIGHT AND TRY TO EARN REWARDS? YOU CAN RIGHT NOW![/url]

[h2][u]Discover the Qilby Pack[/u][/h2]

[b]Take his iconic robe for yourself, and reexplore the world accompanied by his sister Shinonome![/b]
Remove any obstacles in your way with your Wakfu arm, and make the world acknowledge your destiny: you are one of the Firstborn…
 
[url=https://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/announcements/1470785-qilby-pack-wisdom-madness]NOW AVAILABLE IN THE SHOP![/url]
 
[h2][u]Manually Allocate RAM to the Game Client[/u][/h2]
Make sure your [b]game client is stable and efficient by manually allocating its associated RAM[/b] in the Ankama Launcher settings!
 
[url=https://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/announcements/1459515-allocate-more-ram-improve-performance]FOLLOW THE GUIDE![/url]

[b]WAKFU – New Horizons: Adventure Awaits![/b]
 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1lbWW8kGQT0
 
[h3][u][b]Changelog[/b][/u][/h3]
[b]To read: [url=https://www.wakfu.com/en/forum/199-changelogs]Detailed change notes for New Horizons – July 5, 2022[/url][/b]

[i]* In WAKFU, a dungeon's difficulty is determined by Stasis level: as the Stasis level goes up, the dungeon mobs get tougher, but the rewards are also greater. An "average" Stasis level would be 2 (previously level 11).[/i]

notes.title: Let's celebrate WAKFU's birthday together!
notes.notes:
High above in Ingloriom, a red cross falls to the ground from the Krosmic calendar hanging in Xelor's bedroom. A romantic meeting with Feca? A routine check with the family eniripsa? The deadline to pay his enutrof tax? None of the above: WAKFU is celebrating 8 years!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/5553c9172f4edd9cf3805e2900140bb7b88c0e6d.jpg[/img]

1 month, 6 months, 2 years, 4 years, or 8 years for the oldest of old school: it doesn't matter how long you've been writing your History by our side, today it's time for you to join in on the WAKFU Birthday Party! 8 great years of adventure have already flown by... You didn't honestly think we were just going to have a bowl of chips and a little spritzer to celebrate the event, did you? Born on February 29, WAKFU will have the chance this year to celebrate its 8th birthday on the exact day it officially came out!

For the occasion, not one, not two, but three surprises are waiting for you in game this weekend! The gods of the Krosmoz are going all out. Thanks to them, from February 28 4:00 PM (server time) to March 1 11:59 PM (server time), XP gained will be doubled in combat, on all professions and on drops.

In a rush to get the festivities started, Xelor has already gotten a head start by offering you a surprise that will allow you to express your joy in a very krosmiversal way starting February 28... This gift is for all players active since 01/01/2019.

To top it off, we are offering all players 3 days of God Booster. To redeem it, simply enter the birthday code on the [url=www.wakfu.com/en/codes]Gift Code[/url] page


WAKANNIVERSARY2020
The code is available until Monday, March 2, 2020, and valid once per account.


We hope to see many of you in game!

notes.title: Update 1.66: Welcome to the Sadida Kingdom!
notes.notes:
We've moved heaven and earth, we've toiled day and night: now it's time for you to harvest what we planted! A brand spanking new Sadida Kingdom awaits you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4461458/e1e9ddf48ab3242b968eb12152a6cf25bbf58d66.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]The Sadida Kingdom at Its Finest[/b][/h1]

Now prettier, bigger, and more transmedia-fied, the Sadida Kingdom has risen to the level of its reputation. We felt that this iconic locale didn't match the grandeur of what you see in the [b]WAKFU animated series[/b]. But now it does!

[*] [b]4 new zones:
[*] Boowolf Clearing
[*] Web-Entangled Hill
[*] Deforested Forest
[*] Gerbean Galleries[/b]


[*] [b]4 different monster families[/b], including 2 new ones
[*] [b]4 related dungeons[/b]
[*] [b]New resources[/b]
[*] As well as [b]new NPCs[/b]
[/list]

There's a preview of what to expect!

For more details, read [url=www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/devblog/tickets/1065725-devblog-sadida-kingdom]the associated devblog[/url].

[b]Now it's up to you to make this new Sadida Kingdom legendary![/b]


[h1][b]Revelations About the Eliocalypse[/b][/h1]
Calm permeates the air in this new bucolic environment. One might be led to believe it has the purest air in the World of Twelve… Of course, there had to be a cloud on the horizon and a charismatic villain to cast a chill over this idyllic scenery! And who better than [b]Count Harebourg[/b]?

It's hard to say what crazy plans he's cooked up, and it's up to you to solve this [b]mystery[/b]. Something tells us it all may have something to do with the [b]Eliocalypse[/b], though.

[b]Now grab your weapons[/b] and show him a thing or two!


[h1][b]The Haven Bag Chest is Changing[/b][/h1]
With all those items you collect, it gets tricky storing and finding everything… So we've made some improvements! With this update, we've changed a lot about how the Haven Bag chest works. To learn all about it, read the [url=www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/devblog/tickets/1066625-devblog-haven-bag-chest-changing]devblog[/url] dealing with this revolutionary change!



[url=www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/patch-notes/sadida]Wait no more! Check out the new WAKFU update, now in game![/url]

You can find all the changes in our [url=www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/patch-notes/1076850-sadida-kingdom]changelog[/url].


Enjoy the latest update!

notes.title: Update 1.63: Looks and Stasis is Online!
notes.notes:
"How do I look?" the warrior asked his guild solemnly as he was about to enter the dungeon. Everyone looked elsewhere. Then, the bravest in the group confessed: "Well… meh, boss! Tellin' the truth, y'hair… it's all wrong!"

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461458/b68a285552aaf58b319b189295e4e5f79ea4521c.png[/img]

No offense… We all have bad hair days!

Still, it's difficult to be taken seriously in combat when your locks look like they belong on a Sadida doll. Get a hold of them! [b]Graphical customization of characters is being enhanced[/b] in this update and will allow you to be your best… in terms of appearance, at least. But looks aren't everything. That's why you can also enjoy the [b]advancement in Stasis dungeons[/b] and the new possibilities that come with it! So, on the program:
 
[h1]The Advancement in Stasis Dungeons[/h1]
What if you could customize your dungeons too? [url=https://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/devblog/tickets/978392-devblog-stasis]Bring them up to your [b]level[/b][/url] now and rediscover them – with greater difficulty come greater [b]rewards![/b]
 
[h1]Greater Character Appearance Customization[/h1]
[b][url=https://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/devblog/tickets/980477-devblog-1-63-looks]More headwear, more colors[/url]:[/b]Now's the time to give yourself a makeover, so go wild!

 
[url=https://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/patch-notes/978529-looks-stasis]READ THE CHANGELOG[/url]

Log in to the game now to check out the new WAKFU update!

And keep an eye on the store – a surprise should be coming your way shortly…

notes.title: The Advent Calendar Is Here!
notes.notes:
You've been anxiously waiting for days, and now [b]the Advent Calendar is on its way[/b]: there's [b]25 riddles to solve and 26 gifts to win! [/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461458/25ea5c3055326e6a54129f15a183167d71ab3941.jpg[/img]

[b]Kwismas[/b] is fast approaching, but our [b]overwhelming urge to spoil you[/b] seems even faster! The [b][url=www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/advent-calendar]Advent Calendar[/url][/b] is here again, and like every year, you're in for [b]an avalanche of gifts [/b]to make you quiver with delight!

The idea behind the game is the same as before. [b]You'll be asked riddles[/b] [b]and if you answer them correctly[/b] [b](one per day), you win whatever's behind the corresponding square.[/b] This should tide you over before the big day, when little Father Kwismas descends from the sky bearing thousands of presents. Though he might come bearing coal, depending on how well-behaved you were this year…

You Krosmoz experts out there, those for whom the Brotherhood of the Tofu, Stasis, and the creatures and resources of the WAKFU universe hold no secrets, and who will therefore [b]correctly solve all the riddles, will get an extra gift on December 25![/b] [b]If you have an active Booster on this date, you'll receive this 26th gift as well, even if you only answer the December 25 riddle. [/b]

See you on [b][u][url=www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/advent-calendar]December 1st at 10 a.m. (GMT +1)![/url][/u][/b]

[b]New creatures,[/b] the [b]Yokai,[/b] have left their burrows to invade the far corners of Astrub. It appears that these [b]little Lenald-like ghosts[/b] have been [b]possessed by a mysterious evil…[/b] With [b]Pumpkwins[/b] and [b]mummies[/b] to boot, the Twelvians really didn't need this! notes.title: Known issues following the 1.57 update -13.12.17
notes.notes:
In order to keep you informed of Update 1.57's bugs, we decided to write an article to gather them and thus avoid duplicates in the forum's bug section. You will find the list of the bugs known to the team as well as their status.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461458/f29f8564f2ea6b44a77dfe120743e6b0ace0676e.jpg[/img]

We confirmed the following issues :
[list]
	[*][b]After selecting the neutral alignment, the character will not be able to perform any action outside Astrub (fight, plant, access to the markets and Haven-Worlds ..).[/b]

	[i]We found the source of the problem, it will be corrected with an upcoming hotfix.[/i][/*]
	[*][b]Citizenship points are reset each time a character logs in.[/b]

	[i]We found the source of the problem, it will be corrected with an upcoming hotfix. You will recover all the lost points.[/i][/*]
	[*][b]On Kwismas island, sidekicks can join the fight but they do not transform into Kwismas elves. [/b]

	[i]We found the source of the problem, it will be corrected with an upcoming hotfix.[/i][/*]
	[*][b]The Boss from the Forgotten Lair no longer summons totems.[/b]

	[i]We found the source of the problem, it will be corrected with an upcoming hotfix.[/i][/*]
	[*][b]In the high level version of the Mineral Tower, in some cases the player may find himself stuck in the cinematic with Arpagone.[/b]

	[i]We found the source of the problem, it will be corrected with an upcoming hotfix.[/i][/*]
	[*][b]The Ouginak class book does not display the right images.[/b]

	[i]We found the source of the problem, it will be corrected with an upcoming hotfix.[/i][/*]
	[*][b]The Souvenir items « Black Drheller Hat » and « Black Drheller Cloak » cannot be crafted.[/b]

	[i]We found the source of the problem, it will be corrected with an upcoming hotfix.[/i][/*]
	[*][b]In some cases, Environmental Quest resources are protected for 5 minutes.[/b]

	[i]We found the source of the problem, it will be corrected with an upcoming hotfix.[/i][/*]
	[*][b]It is not possible to validate the guild quest rewarding 20 points for the completion of a dungeon.[/b]

	[i]We found the source of the problem, it will be corrected with an upcoming hotfix.[/i][/*]
	[*][b]The scores of the Mineral Tower are not properly updating for all.[/b]

	[i]We found the source of the problem, it will be corrected with an upcoming hotfix.[/i][/*]
[/list]

This article will be updated regularly to keep you informed of the evolution of these bugs. We will only collect here the new bugs that occurred with the release of the 1.57 Update.

If you encounter problems that are not mentioned above, please post a bug report [url=https://www.wakfu.com/en/forum/325-1-57-bug-reports]here[/url].  

We thank you for your patience and we apologize for the inconvenience while our team is working on resolving them.

[i][b]Update 14.12.17 - 4:50 PM CET:[/b] We found the cause of the problem of the environmental quests resources, this problem will be corrected with an upcoming hotfix! Thank you for your feedback.

[b]Update 14.12.17 - 5:45 PM CET: [/b]We added two new bugs to the list. We also found the source of the citizenship points issue! Thank you all for your feedback.[/i]

notes.title: Update 1.55: Zinit - Part 4 is online!
notes.notes:
While Ogrest does have an obnoxious tendency to dominate center stage, he's not the only guest in Update 1.55 – far from it. Sure, he may be the main course. But the side dishes are nothing to sneeze at either: rebalancing, redesigns, rewards, and interfaces… There's no shortage of new features to sink your teeth into!

For the complete menu with all the juicy details, check out the [url=https://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/patch-notes/746770-mount-zinit-part-4][b]changelog[/b][/url]!

But if you're really starving for a taste, here's a little appetizer
[list]	[*]Pet redesign[/*]	[*]New interface for professions[/*]	[*]Fusion of the three Weapons Master professions[/*]	[*]New rewards in end-of-season chests[/*]	[*]Redesign of the Riktus, Crackler, and Field Plants families[/*]	[*]A new spell mechanic that the Srams are going to love…[/*][/list]

All in all, it should be enough to keep you busy until your next trip up Mount Zinit!

Welcome to the new update!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_YMb_GL1M4E

[i]Note that Mount Zinit Part 1, 2, 3, and 4 is accessible if you have a Booster Pack. [/i]

notes.title: Update 1.53: Mount Zinit - Part 2
notes.notes:
Discover the content of Update 1.53. The Mount Zinit Part 2 update will be available on Thursday, May 4th! 

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/ankama/cms/images/273/2017/04/28/682319.jpg[/img]


[h1]Mount Zinit Part 2[/h1]

Have you already wandered through the first part of Mount Zinit and arrived at the mysterious ship embedded in the mountain’s lower slope? Do you spend your evenings pondering what’s behind the silo? There’s a whole new adventure awaiting you in part two of Mount Zinit! 

On the program:
[list]	
[*]3 new zones to explore.[/*]	[*]1 quest to discover.[/*]	[*]3 new monster families to fight.[/*]	[*]3 dungeons to get through.[/*]	[*]New objects to retrieve and to make.[/*][/list] The new content is for players of level 150 to 200!

[url=http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/devblog/tickets/680917-devblog-mount-zinit-part-2]Mount Zinit -  Part 2 Devblog[/url]

 
[h1]The maximum level for professions unlocked[/h1] 
[url=http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/devblog/tickets/674498-devblog-level-100-professions]Increase your professional skills beyond level 100[/url] thanks to modifications in this new update. The highest resources are now at level 125 and the highest recipes at level 130. It’s still possible to gain experience points over level 130.

The experience required at each professional level has been reduced. Players keep all their experience from before the update, which allows you to gain a few professional levels.

 
[h1]Transition to Zinit: Xelorium and Moon Island[/h1]

The [url=http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/announcements/676899-astrub-model]"Astrub Model”[/url] applies in the Xelorium and Moon Island zones. To summarize, this means that in these zones:
[list]	[*]Environmental Quests (EQ) are divided into 4 categories: solo, dash, competitive and collaborative. Collaborative quests let you trigger hordes and invasions. An archmonster has just appeared in the zone too. EQ allow you to obtain the Souper-Glou, a crucial resource for all the equipment recipes![/*]	[*]The dungeons are more dynamic. The level of monsters varies, which influences their characteristics and Initiative.[/*]	[*]Obtaining items based on their rarity has been modified.[/*]	[*]Equipment can be improved through the professions.[/*][/list]
To learn about all the details of the “Astrub Model” changes, click on this link: [url=http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/announcements/676899-astrub-model]here[/url].
 
[h1]Character creation interface[/h1] 
The character creation interface has been slightly modified to add more information for new players. Stars indicate the level of difficulty to master a character class and pictograms with descriptions tell players about the class’s roles (damage, support, tank, etc.).

These changes are mainly for new players arriving in The World of Twelve for the first time.


The [b]Mount Zinit Part 2 [/b]update will be available on [b]Thursday, May 4th[/b]! 

[u]Note that Mount Zinit Part 1 and 2 will only be accessible for players with an active Booster Pack. [/u]
 

Watch the trailer
https://youtu.be/HuPZR5e05tE

notes.title: Update 1.52: Zinit is Ours!
notes.notes:
Starting Tuesday, March 21st, Update 1.52 will take us to the assault on Mount Zinit!
[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/ankama/cms/images/273/2017/03/20/663169.jpg[/img]
Some players took advantage of the [b]Beta[/b] to explore and test content from the new update ahead of time. Everyone else will have to wait ‘til [b]next Tuesday[/b] but you might already have an idea of what’s coming thanks to the devblogs on Update 1.52’s three main subjects.
 
[h1]Mount Zinit, Part One![/h1]

Trek through new lands and take on new challenges waiting for you in the new territory! Mount Zinit Part One is designed for players of levels 50 to 140 and includes:
[list]	[*]3 zones divided into 5 ecosystems. The Astrub model applied at the end of last year is also applied in the new zone! New mercenary quests, environmental quests and archmonsters to take on![/*]	[*]1 main quest to discover[/*]	[*]5 dungeons to explore, each with its own touch of strategy... watch out![/*]	[*]5 families of monsters to fight[/*]	[*]Hundreds of new items (including new epics) and resources to collect[/*]	[*]The possibility to increase an item’s rarity up to “legendary” rarity (“mythical” for items below level 110) by crafting![/*][/list]
Get ready to fight hard before the second part of Mount Zinit appears out of the clouds, with even tougher challenges!
 
[url=http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/devblog/tickets/657094-devblog-mount-zinit]MOUNT ZINIT PART 1 DEVBLOG[/url]

  
[h1]Dungeons Leaderboard[/h1]

The logical development from Stasis dungeons, the dungeons leaderboard lets you compare your progress in the dungeons and rank yourself against other players. To be ranked, it’s simple:
[list]	[*]Tick the “Competitive mode” box in the dungeon’s opening interface[/*]	[*]Select your Stasis difficulty level setting for the dungeon[/*]	[*]Make it through all of the dungeon’s rooms alive![/*][/list]
The higher your ranking, the more interesting gifts you'll collect!

Every month the rankings are set back to zero so you can try to improve your position on the leaderboard. Every month your progress is recorded in a special tab in the interface that lets you view past rankings easily.

[url=http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/devblog/tickets/660540-devblog-dungeon-leaderboard]DUNGEONS LEADERBOARD DEVBLOG[/url] 

 
[h1]Sacrier Revamp[/h1]

After the survey published last January 26th on our website asking, “which class do you think needs improvement?”, Sacrier emerged at the top of the list! Consequently, we have slightly adjusted our original schedule to offer you this update, which improves the class and was initially planned for June!

On the program:
[list]	[*]Tanking mechanic revised to strengthen the Sacrier’s main role – taking the hard knocks![/*]	[*]Greater synergy between the branches. The Fire/Earth branch lets you focus your gameplay on damage and the tank mechanic, while the Fire/Air branch lets focus your gameplay on damage and positioning.[/*]	[*]New mechanics, especially in punishments[/*]	[*]The passive spell “Clinging to Life” is more interesting[/*]	[*]Lots of other things for you to discover![/*][/list]
 
[url=http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/devblog/tickets/661107-sacrier-revamp]SACRIER REVAMP DEVBLOG[/url]
 

The [b]“Mount Zinit Part 1” update[/b] hits your screens on [b]Tuesday, March 21st[/b]!

[u]This new area will only be accessible for players with an active Booster Pack. The previous content, the Ultimate Boss Nogord Wungleezard, will then be accessible to everyone.[/u]

 
Watch the trailer https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PA8iUYH_6No

notes.title: 1.51 Serial Crafters: now online!
notes.notes:
This new update has been revealed bit by bit on the forums and through an entire [url=http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/devblog/tickets/624666-devblog-secure-crafting]Devblog[/url]. It's time to go over what awaits you before you throw yourself into non-stop crafting, whether it's with your fellow Guild members or with complete strangers!

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2017-02-03/b38a2026670c7804d896e29d0a79ff78.jpg[/img]

[h1]Secure Crafting: craft carefree![/h1]

This new feature allows you to securely get items crafted by craftsmen. Easy to use, all you have to do is go into a craftsman's Haven Bag in order to use their machines, in exchange for a small gratuity. As they say, hard work deserves payment!

If you're a craftsman, it's just as easy. Go into your Haven Bag, configure your machines, set your gratuity, and you're ready to offer your services to whoever needs them.

You no longer need to give your hard earned resources to just anyone. Keep them warm in your inventory, and use your craftsmen's machines to craft the items you need yourself.

The full Devblog can be [url=http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/devblog/tickets/624666-devblog-secure-crafting]read[/url] here.
 
[h1]Dungeon Tokens[/h1]

This token-related modification has been implemented in order to encourage occasional players to acquire them. Tokens are still of a safe and fixed value, allowing you to obtain equipment without the need to rely on luck. They are now obtained on a daily/weekly basis, rather than at each dungeon.

[b]How do I get tokens?[/b] (the values are the ones obtained with a Booster Pack. Without a Booster Pack, divide the values by two)
[list]	[*][b]One daily quest[/b] requiring you to complete a dungeon will give you 20 tokens.[/*]	[*][b]Daily quests[/b] requiring you to retrieve 10 seeds, giving you 2 tokens. With an average of 4 families of monsters per level group, you can receive up to 8 tokens per level group.[/*]	[*][b]Daily quests[/b] requiring you to retrieve 10 resources, giving you 4 tokens. With an average of 4 families of monsters per level group, you can receive up to 16 tokens per level group.[/*]	[*][b]One weekly quest[/b] requiring you to complete all of the dungeons in a level group (4 dungeons), giving you 80 tokens.[/*]	[*][b]Mercenary quests[/b] giving you 4 tokens for easy quests, 8 tokens for those involving fights, 8 tokens for difficult quests and mini games, and lastly 20 tokens for those requiring you to complete a dungeon.[/*]	[*][b]Dungeon achievements[/b] giving you 10 tokens for each achievement, giving a total of 40 tokens if you complete them all.[/*]	[*]Also, it is still possible to exchange [b]Modulox Tokens[/b] in the machine at the Astrub Inn for tokens of the chosen level.[/*][/list][h1]Machine items are no longer linked[/h1]
Items obtained from machines are no longer linked; it is therefore possible to resell them or to give them to your friends as gifts. Actually, since obtaining these items with the new system is more balanced than the previous one, there's no longer any reason to keep them linked to the account (except for ones involving Ultimate Bosses).

But that's not all! Items will also no longer be linked once equipped. However, be careful: linked items you already own will remain linked.


[b]Get ready, Update 1.51 will be here on Tuesday, February 7th![/b]

notes.title: The 1.50 update released tomorrow, December 13!
notes.notes:
Baptised [b]“Lairs and Lizards”[/b], elements of this update were unveiled in our various devblogs and articles published these last few weeks. It’s time to sum up what awaits you before meeting the terrifying Nogord Wungleezareed!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461458/c849293223cacff8e08df9d55a7b0b5f418a1bb5.jpg[/img]


[h1]
Stasis Dungeons: adjust the difficulty of a dungeon![/h1]

This new feature will allow you to adjust the difficulty of a dungeon as you like. Has the Gobball Dungeon become too easy for your liking? Correct it by corrupting the monsters with Stasis! And on the other hand: the [u]krazy[/u] Kanniballs getting you down? Lower the difficulty and come back later to put them in their place.

With this new feature, you will gain experience and rewards according to the difficulty set!

There are 50 levels of difficulty that await you, divided into 5 levels (of difficulty): 
[list]	[*]Rapid (1-10)[/*]	[*]Normal (11-20)[/*]	[*]Difficult (21-30)[/*]	[*]Expert (31-40)[/*]	[*]Master (41-50)[/*][/list]
By default, dungeons will be set to [u]Rapid [/u]or [u]Normal[/u] difficulties. By completing the dungeons at these levels, you’ll unlock the harder difficulties! For example, the famous Gobball Dungeon will need to be successfully completed at difficulty 20 to unlock difficulties 21 to 30!

The new dungeon entry interface will allow you to keep an eye on the difficulties you have unlocked. In conjunction with the Adjustable Level System, you can, at the click of a button, set the level of your character and adjust it to the level of the dungeon.

The keys, required to access WAKFU’s dungeons, have been removed to simplify the system and reduce the punishment suffered in the event of defeat! You’ll be free to test the difficulties of the dungeon to your liking and put some spice (or rather, Stasis) in your adventure!  

Find more information about the Stasis Dungeons in this dedicated [url=http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/devblog/tickets/599946-devblog-stasis-dungeons]Devblog[/url]!

 [h1]Quest of Nations - Chapter 5[/h1]

The fifth and final chapter of the epic Quest of Nations arrives in this new update!

Direct yourselves to Sufokia to complete the last leg of your adventure. Fret not, for you won’t be alone! The well-known arkaeologists, Laura Craft and Jenry Hones Jr. will accompany you on the final chapter.

[b]Chapter 5 in the Quest of Nations includes the following content:[/b]
[list]	
[*]A 4-part quest for level 45 (or above) players, continuing on from Chapter 4 in the Quest of Nations (a pre-requisite)[/*]	[*]A visit to sandy Sufokia and Oktapodas’ Sunken Temple for a whole ton of surprises[/*]	[*]An epic dungeon adventure[/*]	[*]A new 9-piece hero set: the Tenacious Hero Set[/*]	[*]Haven Bag decorations, titles and tons of rewards to unlock or purchase from the dungeon croupier[/*]	[*]Last but not least, a new artifact, that will open up many new horizons in your exploration of the World of Twelve[/*]	[*]Not to mention, some extra surprises and twists![/*][/list]
Are you ready for this new adventure?

Find out more about this last chapter of the Quest for Nations in this [url=http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/devblog/tickets/598848-quest-nations-chapter-5]Devblog[/url]!

 [h1]New Ultimate Boss: Nogord Wungleezareed[/h1]

Bow to the big bad boss of the update, the legendary Nogord Wungleezared! This new Ultimate Boss is for players level 186 and more! He should keep you up and awake for the long winter nights that await.

Nogord is a prismatic dragon who has mastered the four elements and his gameplay reflects these. Let us warn you right away, Nogord is terribly powerful and you and your teammates will have to correctly anticipate every move if you want to avoid devastating attacks and come out unscathed!

Ha? Still not trembling in your boots? Then know that Nogord has a million life points and under those wings of his, all the cards to roast you, pure and simple!

Head to Inglorium to face him in the next update!

Eager to be champion of champions? Then take part in our contest to be the first to defeat Nogord! You can find all the details [url=http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/announcements/600492-ultimate-boss-nogord-wungleezareed]here[/url]. 

[b]The 1.50 Update: Lairs and Lizards will be released on December 13!

Get ready![/b]

notes.title: Kwismas World: A Winter Wonderland!
notes.notes:
[i] What’s this colour everywhere? Bright lights, fantastical and fabulous baubles! And look! There’s white things in the air… are these snowflakes? What’s that? I swear I can hear music in the air… Huh? Kwismas World… hmm? [/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461458/ce0e98ed84ed6f6ca15879549fbad3a4b0eac5b0.jpg[/img]

[b] WHAT. IS. THAT? [/b]

[i] ♪ Roasting chestnuts by a fire, baked cookies that can only inspire! ♪

♪ Oh, look, tiny little things… dangling from electrical light strings! ♪

All this fuss, for the world of Kwismas!

…I wonder what’s so special about it? [/i]
[list]
[*] 2 Dungeons (Father Kwismas's Workshop and Father Kwismas's House)
[*] 7 Titles
[*] 9 Haven Bag decorations
[*] 1 Kwismas Set
[*] 5 Kwismassy Consumables
[*] 3 Festive Fairyworks
[*] 5 Achievements
[*] 6 monsters: Comman Deer, Gift Packages 1 and 2, Belva Deer, Boobytrapped Package and Father Kwismas

notes.title: Would you like some XP?
notes.notes:
Skank Hivin is the period when the word "generosity" makes sense. Therefore, this is the opportunity for us to offer you a combat and crafting weekend XP bonus... And that's not all!

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2016-11-23/7fa3939db22fce4e72abb67648037f3a.jpg[/img]

From Saturday, November 26th, at 12:01 AM (server time), until Sunday, November 27th at 11:59 PM (server time), enjoy a +50% XP bonus in combat throughout the World of Twelve on WAKFU!

This bonus will not happen by itself since you will also get +50% crafting XP when practicing your favorite profession.

[h1]Do you want more?[/h1]

Because we are always more generous with you, we decided to also offer you 2 Heroes slots throughout the weekend! You will have nothing to do but to activate them, and to be connected to the game to enjoy them fully, of course!

For those who do not know the hero system, small reminder. Thanks to Heroes, you will be able to play one or two additional character (s) and thus form a super team against your opponents. Each character is customizable in the same way as your main character. They gain the same experience, get their own loot and win their own dungeon tokens!

To access the Hero management interface, simply use the default keyboard shortcut (K) and select the characters with which you want to be grouped.

[h1]Do you want even more?[/h1]

If you are not available this weekend, do not panic because another bonus weekend will show the tip of his nose very quickly!

As a compensation for the various problems on our global network infrastructure that impacted our services last week, [b]a weekend bonus (+50% XP combat, +50% XP crafting, +10% drop) is scheduled for the weekend of the 3rd and 4th of December![/b]

We hope you will enjoy these well earned bonuses!
