notes.title: WAKFUNDING: You, us and season 3
notes.notes:
As you already know, after two seasons and three special episodes, the Wakfu series is back for a third season. We're on the right track to thrill you with visual delights and stories that warm your heart, but there's still a long way to go. As usual, we've been looking for a solution that's a little more off the beaten track...

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2016-11-03/5194e821f976c77c4cf46bbe4b71f2ad.jpg[/img]

Fully financing an animation project without compromise is a real struggle. Finding the right partners, discussing with them, trying to convince them and tempering the changes they would like to make takes time.
 
On the other hand, we do have one solid pillar: Our community. You like what we do, the way we do it, and we already have your support. [b]Who better to form a partnership with than you?[/b]
 
[h1]The WAKFUNDING concept[/h1] 
As we've already said, progress on [b]WAKFU season 3[/b] is coming along well.
 
But if we want to maintain the same level of quality until the end, we need to find some additional funding...
 
So, how can we continue this project with the same ambitions and freedom, counting on you, BUT without asking you to contribute more than you already do on a daily basis? The answer's simple. [b]WE'RE the ones who are going to offer you even MORE![/b]
 
How about if we offer you some new items and packs? And what if [b]these exclusive items and packs finance our latest ambitions for WAKFU season 3?[/b]
 
[b]Whether you play DOFUS or WAKFU[/b], or you're simply [b]a fan of the series[/b], the aim of [u]Wakfunding[/u] is to establish [b]a privileged exchange between YOU and US[/b], to build something together, and for everyone to come out a winner.
 
[b]Every Thursday throughout November, we will be offering you new items and packs.[/b] Treat yourself and enjoy the satisfaction of knowing that you're contributing to the creation of your favorite animated series! And that's not all! Everyone who contributes to [u]Wakfunding[/u] will get [b]digital bonuses[/b] from the series in December:
 [list]	[*]Kim Etinoff's presentation: Creating season 3's characters (French language, with English subtitles)[/*]	[*]Vincent Lamassonne's presentation: Season 3's backgrounds (French language, with English subtitles)[/*]	[*]Season 3 concept art collection[/*]	[*]Background pack[/*][/list] 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ebyVjabZsts
 
 [h1][b]THE IN-GAME OFFERS OF THE WEEK[/b][/h1] 
Below, you will find details of the [url=https://secure.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/shop/594-wakfunding][b]offers of the week[/b][/url] in your game: 
[list]	[*][u]Wakfulisk Costume[/u][/*]	[*][u]I am Yugo (Emote)[/u][/*]	[*][u]Percedal Finisher[/u][/*]	[*][u]Wakfu Harness[/u][/*]	[*][u]Drheller Mount[/u][/*][/list][img]http://staticns.ankama.com/comm/news/wakfu/www/11_2016/emoteyugo.gif[/img]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u8yWG6KbedE
[b] 
[url=https://secure.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/shop/594-wakfunding]Available[/url] until Thursday, November 10 2016 (3:00 PM UTC).[/b]


  
[h1][b]ALL THE SERIES ONLY OFFERS[/b][/h1] 
[u]From Thursday, November 10![/u]

What if you're not a player, but you still want to play a part in the series' creation? No problem! Two new packs of items and goodies inspired by the WAKFU series will soon be available from the [b]Ankama Shop[/b]! Visit us on Thursday, November 10 to find out more!
 
Treat yourself while contributing to the financing of the 3rd season of your favorite animated series! 

 
[b]For more information, go to the [url=http://www.wakfu.com/en/wakfunding]Wakfunding page[/url].[/b]

[b]Come back next Thursday for new content and packs![/b]

notes.title: Update 1.49: The Adjustable Level System
notes.notes:
[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2016-10-28/fcf7d04b680399b0005519a8e58f6d6c.jpg[/img]
They are here! [b]The Adjustable Level, Rapid Builds and Mentoring Systems come into play on Wednesday November 2nd[/b]!

We have not stopped since the last update "[b]New Times in Astrub[/b]" and we have continued to improve these features with the goal to make them easy to access for all our players.

From now on you'll be able to change your level in a few clicks (3 to be exact) directly from your character interface.

The drop-down menu located at the top of the interface will allow you to change your base level. Therefore, the level of all spells will be equal to your character’s level. The skills/spells and characteristics of your character will also be changed automatically, which will allow you to discover the contents of this level normally without having to manage anything!

This is the simple method to adjust your level, because here everything is done automatically.

For those who want to go even further, you will have the opportunity to create your own build* specific to each level.

This means you will be able to choose the skills/spells you want, and the equipment items of your choice for the character that best suits you in the moment.

[i]*A build is a set of skills/spells and equipment items that represent all the characteristics of a character while in combat. For example: for an Iop, you can have two different builds:[/i]

[list][*][u]"Area of damage Fire Iop" playing Iop's Wrath.[/u][/*]
[*][u]"Single target damage Air Iop" playing with combos.[/u][/*][/list]

By adjusting your level, you will be able to fully enjoy the Mentoring system too. If you help a few new players with your "adjusted level" character, you will earn tokens that can be exchanged at the machine located in the Tavern in Astrub.

Many exclusive rewards will await you, such as: [list]	[*]Costumes[/*]	[*]A new Harness[/*]	[*]Several emotes[/*]	[*]Consumables[/*]	[*]Titles[/*]	[*]And much more...[/*][/list] 

Here is a glimpse of the costume and harness! Any interest anyone?

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2016-10-28/1ec036ffe2da36643b65a2788767b7bd.jpg[/img][h1]Mentor's Costume[/h1]

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2016-10-28/46a3c7ebaa8cb1bcf70129d005e5b273.jpg[/img][h1]Mentor's Costume[/h1]

[i]We were talking earlier about a new feature that will accompany the Adjustable Level system, which is the "[/i][b]Automatic Dungeon[/b][i]" feature.[/i]

This gives the [b]possibility to enter a dungeon automatically adjusted to the appropriate level[/b]. Once a player of the group enters an automatically adjusted dungeon; all members of the group who wish to join will also have to adjust their level to the dungeon.

For example, if you are two level 200 players in your group and you decide to run the Abandoned Scarapit (level 22), your character will automatically move to the next adjusted level (namely 35), once in the dungeon.

That is because, we remind you that it is possible to adjust only to the following levels: 20, 35, 50, 65, 80, 98, 110, 125, 140, 155, 170 and 185.

Upon [b]completion of the dungeon while having it adjusted[/b] (thanks to the automatic dungeon or even by having reduced its level manually), [b]players will win a token that will be used in all the machines of the game[/b].

Note that once entering a dungeon thanks to the automatic system, you'll be able to change build for the same level at any time. You will then be able to switch between an automatic build to a personal build as you would like. However, you will not be able to use a build of a different level!

Also another important fact using the example of the Abandoned Scarapit: while you are set on an automatically level 35 build throughout the dungeon, we understood that you may want to use your own build once you are at the boss. This will be possible but with a [b]build of level 35 only[/b]!

That's not all! Do you plan to go see Otomaï in Incarnam ? Guess what? you will be able to retrieve a [b]Finisher[/b]! But what is that? (we can already hear you wonder). This is an [b]animation that is triggered under certain conditions late in the fight[/b] and that will make your last combat action, even more awesome. What a way to finish your opponent in style!
 
Be prepared, as the 1.49 update will be implemented on Wednesday, November 2nd!

Watch our latest video about the Adjustable Level System here: https://youtu.be/hiXQTONTYx4

notes.title: Al Howin: The Return
notes.notes:
Another year, another haunted festival: Al Howin! What would this celebration be without a little trick and… lots of treats! Defend the World of Twelve from troublemakers that only celebrate by spreading curses and stealing candy. The spooky event starts today!

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2016-10-25/fb54c30f6fe4320f4996071aa25ca4cd.jpg[/img]
From [b]today, 25th of October (10:00 AM server time), to 8th of November (10:00 AM server time)[/b] the wicked witch of Al Howin has returned to curse… and to swear!

It’s time to dispatch her, and her wicked minions from causing chaos. After all, how can little Astrubian trick-and-treaters enjoy themselves with the presence of such danger?

[b]Make Astrub streets safe again and be rewarded for it. Here are the details:[/b] 
[list]	[*]An exclusive dungeon available in Astrub for the duration of the event.[/*]	[*]A legion of Cursed Gobballs.[/*]	[*]Villagers with an unusual appearance: the “Pumpkwinner”.[/*]	[*]Almokens, Almokens, Almokens![/*][/list]
[b]Take part this year for the chance of new rewards (in addition to [/b][url=http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/announcements/443777-howin-curse-pumpkwin][b]last year’s[/b][/url][b] rewards):[/b]
 [list]	[*]4 new exclusive Haven Bag decorations.[/*][/list][img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2016-10-24/1a096ed5d9071caf2c06711372db2b4c.png[/img][img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2016-10-24/3d6043e91e065015fcb36b88a9805fff.png[/img][img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2016-10-24/4113ca0e4c474299320230e9f75a836f.png[/img][img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2016-10-24/044386913c81a9d5a1ca37e1285b6709.png[/img]
 
 [list]	[*]1 exclusive costume.[/*][/list][img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2016-10-24/815f90fccce47a9bc7a83b0ef67903fa.png[/img]

notes.title: New Times in Astrub: It's online!
notes.notes:
You’re feeling pretty excited, and that’s to be expected. The “New Times in Astrub” update is online! The ultimate boss Sham Moon is ready and waiting for you, but he’s not the only one! Oh, and be careful when guzzling down wines from the Villainy Vineyard…

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2016-10-10/b45f0752975bdcaa7f6c1131d7a47086.jpg[/img]
 
[b]The new Update 1.48 is online![/b] On the agenda is [url=http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/announcements/581168-doctor-darkli-mister-sham]a monkey[/url] who doesn’t dance for any organ-grinder, [url=http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/announcements/583781-visit-villainy-vineyards]a vineyard[/url] that will give you some real sorrows to drown, and a brand new Astrub. Want to know more? Read on!
 
[h1]Astrub Revamp[/h1]

Intrepid explorers starting out their first steps into the World of Twelve will be pleased to know that Astrub’s varied regions can’t be explored in just one day!

The revamped island of Astrub features a sleepy fishing hamlet, golden fields of wheat and barley, thick forests featuring sentient trees (yes, sentient!) and towering mountain ranges watching down over the city. With all these sights, and many more, even the World of Twelve’s proudest nations can’t help but to rear their heads with envy.

Oh, and before we forget, steer clear from the southern crypts if you want to keep your head (and maybe even your soul!)

In the [u]revamped[/u] Astrub you will find:
 
[list]	[*]New regions with their own ecosystems, monsters and Clan Members.[/*]	[*]‘Day and Night’ cycles.[/*]	[*]Weather effects![/*][/list]
 
 [h1]New Dungeon: Villainy Vineyards[/h1]
You’ve probably taken a stroll through a Pandawa brewery and thought, ‘yeah, this seems like a jolly place – oh, a pint of Bamboo Milk? Another? Sure. Uh… another? I think I’ve had enough… oh, go on then!’

Well, whatever you thought about Pandawa breweries, forget it! Monk Island’s  ‘[u]Villainy Vineyard’ [/u]works a little differently: you’re more likely to end up leaving in a coffin than inebriated… or maybe in a coffin… inebriated!

The wine created here has become such a symbol of danger, that merely possessing a bottle tells the rest of the world that you fear nothing and if you don’t feel prepared, you can read about it in the devblog by clicking [url=http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/announcements/583781-visit-villainy-vineyards]here[/url].

 [h1]Ultimate Boss: Sham Moon[/h1]
We were going to tell you all about WAKFU’s next Ultimate Boss but we’ve got a bit of a monkey problem right now... all you need to know is that while this monkey might be a sham, he's here to cause trouble and it'll take the bravest heroes to put him in his place!

After all, the survivors will be privy to...
 [list]	[*]A complete Set (8 items) at the token machine.[/*]	[*]4 crafted items.[/*]	[*]3 looted items, including 1 epic rarity, 1 emblem in seven different versions.[/*]	[*]1 relic to craft at the end of a hard-to-get quest.[/*][/list]
Oh, and the first group to defeat this boss will be handsomely rewarded! Read all about this event [url=http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/announcements/587100-event-server-first-sham-moon]here[/url]. 

 [h1]Quest of Nations: Chapter 4[/h1]
If you haven’t started the Quest of Nations yet (or completed Chapters 1, 2 or 3)… [b]STOP READING NOW![/b]

For the 4th Chapter of the Quest of Nations, you’ll be driven to a city housing the World of Twelve’s sly, twisted and the downright scumbags (sorry Brakmarians!).

You guessed it! Brakmar will be the stage for the next part of this epic quest. With the help of a guide, journey into the slums of the city and investigate the property of one of Brakmar’s biggest tycoons, leading you on a quest to, perhaps, quite literally feel the flames of’s toasty underbelly.

What does the quest involve?
 [list]	[*]A 3-part quest for level 35 (or above) players, continuing on from Chapter 3 in the Quest of Nations (a pre-requisite).[/*]	[*]A visit to a normal Brakmarian neighborhood (in other words, a dive!).[/*]	[*]New and colorful, full-blooded Brakmarian characters.[/*]	[*]A majestic dungeon adventure.[/*]	[*]A new 9-piece hero set: the [u]Tough Hero[/u] set.[/*]	[*]Haven Bag decorations, titles and tons of rewards to unblock or purchase from the dungeon croupier.[/*]	[*]Not to mention the third and latest Orichalcum, which opens the doors to the final chapter in a coming update![/*][/list]
Starving to know more? Journey to the Sidimote Moors ingame or read more about the quest in the devblog [url=http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/devblog/tickets/586556-quest-nations-chapter-4]here[/url].
 

Hurry and experience the latest update, come and join us in-game now!

notes.notes:

notes.title: ICYMI: A new dungeon and quest!
notes.notes:
At the start of [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/215080/announcements/detail/967533929220452765]September[/url], we revealed some of the content coming in the next update of WAKFU. If you haven't been following our website, then we have to slices of content-cake just for you!

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2016-08-30/69bd8b7a7448c7c02c63155343cb2912.jpg[/img]

[b][h1]Visit the Villainy Vineyards[/h1][/b]
[i]In this ancient building, restored by a mysterious lady, a wine that is greatly sought after by the Twelvian nobility is made! Not one gala night, not a single consular party, fails to serve this wine to guests, and everyone takes the obligatory sip! The taste is so horrendous, the color so murky, the acidity so scorching, that is known the world over as being the worst wine ever produced! 

Legend tells of foolhardy adventurers that have ventured inside, dying in the most excruciating pain imaginable. The wine has become such a symbol of danger, that merely possessing a bottle tells the rest of the world that you fear nothing.[/i]

Want to know more? [url=http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/announcements/583781-visit-villainy-vineyards]Click here[/url] to read the full article on our website.

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2016-09-12/fcec707014ad1e213aa27cf28bac9905.jpg[/img]

[b][h1]Quest of Nations - Chapter 4[/h1][/b]
[i]The main adventure in WAKFU MMO is back with the fourth chapter in the Quest of Nations.

Some of you have already guessed, this chapter includes a visit deep into the entrails of Brakmar. You will be spared nothing – lies, bribery, low blows, corruption, dark alleys and so much more. You will have to learn to pass unnoticed and sometimes show a little muscle to get what you want from the mysterious and intimidating industrial tycoon.

Lucky for you, Eminerell Lebbocq is there to guide you through this den of vice, through the slums that lead to Charles-Henri of Vileardent's factory. But... could the mission really be that simple?[/i]

You can read the full story, written by Game Designer [i]Ryf[/i], on our website by [url=http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/devblog/tickets/586556-quest-nations-chapter-4]clicking here[/url].

[h1]All of this is coming in the next update of WAKFU![/h1]

notes.title: 1.48: WHAT'S IN STORE?
notes.notes:
Have you been frozen in time by the mighty Xelor? No? Have you been napping like a lazy Iop? ...No? Well, whatever the reason, in case you missed it, here's a breakdown of what will be coming in the next update of WAKFU!

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2016-08-29/103c92cc12b393d10bd6f50e2fafc330.jpg[/img]

The WAKFU teams haven't spent summer larking about, and they are ready for the back-to-school season! Here's a glimpse of what they have concocted for you in the next update!
 
[*]The Astrub redesign.
[*]A new ultimate boss: Sham Moon.
[*]Chapter 4 in the Quest of Nations.
[*]The adjustable level system - [i]This feature has been delayed, more details: [url=http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/announcements/586974-adjustable-levels-postponed]here[/url][/i]
[*]The mentorship system - [i]This feature has been delayed, more details: [url=http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/announcements/586974-adjustable-levels-postponed]here[/url][/i]
[*]The Viticultists' Dungeon, you can read about it here: http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/announcements/583781-visit-villainy-vineyards[/list]
 
All of that?! That's right! Of course, over the next few days (and weeks) there will be devblogs and a range of other publications explaining all of this new stuff! That should keep you skipping all the way to the end of summer!

notes.title: Reincarnamation is online!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461458/d32508cb00d8337962fab015c02d23cdb24e3bfd.jpg[/img]

Whether you’re a seasoned adventurer or a fearful noob, this update was made for you! From Incarnam to Moon Island, via the beaches of Bilbiza, you’re sure to find something you love. Update 1.47 is online, so it’s the perfect time to remind you about its new content!

[h1]REINCARNAMATION[/h1]
 
When it comes to welcoming newcomers to WAKFU, we don’t mess around! That’s why a famous character from the Krosmoz is now waiting to meet you at the doors of Incarnam. No, you're not dreaming. Otomai himself will be delighted to accompany you to take your first steps in the World of Twelve!

A brand new tutorial, new monsters, an exclusive new cinematic and so much more. For more information, take a look at the [url=www.wakfu.com/fr/mmorpg/actualites/devblog/billets/547472-devblog-nouvel-incarnam]devblog[/url] dedicated to Incarnam’s makeover.

[h1]MR. FOGGER, AND...[/h1]
 
MRS FOGGER! You’ve been waiting with anticipation, and she’s finally here! The female Foggernaut is now available! A subtle combination of artificial intelligence and beauty. It’s enough to get your enemies hot under the collar and hungry for more.

A Sex and Appearance Change Potion will be given to all accounts that meet the following requirements:

[*]Your account has connected at least once to WAKFU between 1 January 2016 and 10 July 2016. 
[*]A Foggernaut has been created on your account on or before 10 July 2016 9:59 PM UTC.[/list]
Please note that you will only receive 1 Sex and Appearance Change Potion per account regardless of the number of Foggernaut characters you have on the account itself.


[h1]OTOMAI'S DISCIPLES QUEST REVAMP[/h1]
 
Otomaï is most definitely the star of this update! Simplified steps, the revaluation of acquired experience and new rewards! This is what is waiting for you in the new version of the quest dedicated to the cult of the greatest alchemist of all time!

[h1]NEW EVENT: LA MÄDRAGUE[/h1]
 
And because, despite what the grey clouds may imply, summer is definitely underway, come and check out our new [url=www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/announcements/556753-maedrague-makes-event]summer event![/url] You won’t get much chance to sunbathe or make sändcastles here! Because it looks like the Skätes are the ones who need to get fried. These infuriating monsters will do whatever it takes to keep you from sitting back and relaxing! Teach them a lesson and you will be duly rewarded.

[h1]MOON ISLAND ZONE 2[/h1]
 
Once limited to those in possesion of a Booster Pack, the hidden side of Moon Island is now accesible to everybody!

[h1]NEW DUNGEON: STONE PERCH (LEVEL 85)[/h1]
 
Discover another completely mad family of Tofus: the Wild Tofus! Visit each nation’s wild prairie, where they’re ready and waiting for you! And where there’s a new family, there’s also a new dungeon with new equipment to be won!
 
And don’t forget about the resource acquisition rate update, and the changes to the epic and relic items!

Whether you’re a seasoned adventurer or a fearful noob, this update was made for you! From Incarnam to Moon Island, via the beaches of Bilbiza, you’re sure to find something you love. Update 1.47 is online, so it’s the perfect time to remind you about its new content!

[h1]REINCARNAMATION[/h1]
 
When it comes to welcoming newcomers to WAKFU, we don’t mess around! That’s why a famous character from the Krosmoz is now waiting to meet you at the doors of Incarnam. No, you're not dreaming. Otomai himself will be delighted to accompany you to take your first steps in the World of Twelve!

A brand new tutorial, new monsters, an exclusive new cinematic and so much more. For more information, take a look at the [url=www.wakfu.com/fr/mmorpg/actualites/devblog/billets/547472-devblog-nouvel-incarnam]devblog[/url] dedicated to Incarnam’s makeover.

[h1]MR. FOGGER, AND...[/h1]
 
MRS FOGGER! You’ve been waiting with anticipation, and she’s finally here! The female Foggernaut is now available! A subtle combination of artificial intelligence and beauty. It’s enough to get your enemies hot under the collar and hungry for more.

A Sex and Appearance Change Potion will be given to all accounts that meet the following requirements:

[*]Your account has connected at least once to WAKFU between 1 January 2016 and 10 July 2016. 
[*]A Foggernaut has been created on your account on or before 10 July 2016 9:59 PM UTC.[/list]
Please note that you will only receive 1 Sex and Appearance Change Potion per account regardless of the number of Foggernaut characters you have on the account itself.


[h1]OTOMAI'S DISCIPLES QUEST REVAMP[/h1]
 
Otomaï is most definitely the star of this update! Simplified steps, the revaluation of acquired experience and new rewards! This is what is waiting for you in the new version of the quest dedicated to the cult of the greatest alchemist of all time!

[h1]NEW EVENT: LA MÄDRAGUE[/h1]
 
And because, despite what the grey clouds may imply, summer is definitely underway, come and check out our new [url=www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/announcements/556753-maedrague-makes-event]summer event![/url] You won’t get much chance to sunbathe or make sändcastles here! Because it looks like the Skätes are the ones who need to get fried. These infuriating monsters will do whatever it takes to keep you from sitting back and relaxing! Teach them a lesson and you will be duly rewarded.

[h1]MOON ISLAND ZONE 2[/h1]
 
Once limited to those in possesion of a Booster Pack, the hidden side of Moon Island is now accesible to everybody!

[h1]NEW DUNGEON: STONE PERCH (LEVEL 85)[/h1]
 
Discover another completely mad family of Tofus: the Wild Tofus! Visit each nation’s wild prairie, where they’re ready and waiting for you! And where there’s a new family, there’s also a new dungeon with new equipment to be won!
 
And don’t forget about the resource acquisition rate update, and the changes to the epic and relic items!

notes.title: Reincarnamation is coming on the 12th of July!
notes.notes:

You will also find some Foggers looking distinctly fabulous, [url=www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/devblog/tickets/551620-devblog-wild-tofus]savage feathery creatures[/url] and the [url=www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/devblog/tickets/552193-devblog-quest-otomai-disciples]quest of Otomai's Disciples[/url] just got even better! That's not all, Moon Island Zone 2 is now open to everybody!

See you on Tuesday 12th of July in Update 1.47: Reincarnamation!

notes.title: The Hidden Face of Moon
notes.notes:
Today, Moon Island reveals its face! If you look closely, you can see that this crescent-shaped isle is smiling… why? Well, there’s a lot to be happy about: the details of the next update are shared in this article! But that’s not all, we have a trunk full of treasures to share!

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2016-04-08/23bb3e0e7d523e6366e4127b0df79483.jpg[/img]

We know that we have some intrepid explorers out there who have searched the jungles of Moon Island high and low for treasure and secrets. We know that exploring through the vines, with only machete in hand, was no easy feat… but do you think you have uncovered all of Moon Island’s secrets? The thirst for adventure never ends. Today; we announce that the next update will be on… April 12th!

And to help you celebrate, here’s a trunk-load full of treasures coming in the next update:

[h1]The new zone of Moon Island![/h1]

Be wary explorers, for the two new monster families -- the Nyl Crocodyls and the Kannivores lie in wait, with tooth, spear and thorn at the ready.

…And there’s more!

[list][*]2 new dungeons (for levels 176 and 178).
[*]5 new resources in the new zone: ‘The Tunnels.’
[*]10 new mercenary quests
[*]Over 60 new items
[*]Over 15 new crafting recipes
[*]5 new Fabulous Runes[/list]

This new zone is only accessible to players who have an active Booster Pack. The former Moon Island zone (released in update 1.45) is now accessible to ALL!

[h1]Monk Island revamp![/h1]

Even stinky little rats and ill-mannered monks need a makeover once in a while. Well, unfortunately we couldn't do much for their sorry snouts, but with all our power we've given their surroundings a visual revamp! Monk Island has been visually revitalized with one message in mind: more spook and more chills!

[h1]The in-game event, Fleaster![/h1]

From April 12th at 10:00 AM to April 26th at 10:00 AM (server time), get ready to collect eggs and participate in the hunt of your life! Or the opposite... but remember that date because Fleaster is coming back and it will be for players of all levels to enjoy!

Each year, when the first spring buds begin to bloom, the same story repeats itself: the Fleasters are overtaken by a sudden frenzy and begin to lay eggs everywhere! So be careful where you step if you do not want to end up feeling like walking on eggshells! You don’t want to make Etnop sad or angry...

It may well be that the Meridia of Eggs will be overwhelmed during this time and might need a helping hand or two. Don’t you hear his cries for help? We sure do, so collect the Fleaster eggs by farming them, and then take them to the machine, located in the city of Astrub, to choose your reward for your public service!

Please note: The content of this event will be identical to the version from last year, but we feel that these in-game events (and the achievements gained from them) can be appealing to both our new and older players. The arrival of Heroes System between last year’s Fleaster event and this year’s Fleaster event should not cause major problems, however, some environmental quests related to the Fleaster event may cause you to encounter some problems. The reason we have not been able to look in more detail on these issues is because we wanted to focus our efforts on the upcoming patch (and with it, permanent content) rather than the temporary content of this in-game event.

[h1]Water… Earth… Fi…HUPPERMAGES![/h1]

From April 12th, the Huppermage will be available for all players! Find out more about this new class.

In the coming update, we're offering you the opportunity to play the latest class who are able to combine all four elements! Consider that, with this class, the balance of the Krosmoz is in your hands!

From April 12th, the Class Change service will also include Huppermages!  

[h1]Kerubaby , kitty got claws![/h1]

As detailed previously, Kerubaby (Baby Kerubim) joins the game! Players who made a purchase (via real currency or Ogrines) from December 1st, 2014 to April 12th, 2016 will receive this feline fellow!

Your latest pet will be credited to your account sometime after the update. Watch out for news when.

[h1]See you in the World of Twelve on April 12th![/h1]

Well, that’s enough highlights for now… you’ll just have to discover the rest of the changes in-game!

notes.title: Birthday Bonus XP Bonanza!
notes.notes:
Another year against the tide of Ogrest's Chaos. Another year of dungeon-diving and loot-grabbin'. Another year for bruisin' Brakmar bullies (sorry Brakmarians!) Oh, and how could we forget the most important? Another year of birthday bonus XP fun! Help us celebrate WAKFU's 4th birthday ingame!

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2016-02-10/432c6b59e0f41c92f95c11d22c5f95d3.jpg[/img]

As it's the birthday weekend of WAKFU, we are going to be offering a bout of BONUS XP for all!
 
From Saturday the 27th of February (00:01 AM server time) until Sunday the 28th of February (11:59 PM server time) all servers will receive double crafting and combat XP and double kamas. And, to put the icing on the cake, we'll also be throwing in free zaaps all weekend!

And don't forget to check out our birthday calendar [url=http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/birthday-calendar]here[/url] - there's still plenty to play for!

An extra day has been given for the Nox, Remington and Phaeris servers due to technical issues that affected gameplay in our previous Bonus XP weekend. Therefore, the bonus XP weekend for those servers will begin on Friday the 26th of February (00:01 AM server time.)

notes.title: The Huppermage pack is here!
notes.notes:
Masters of Light and the four elements, the Huppermages are finally within your grasp! In total, Huppermages have 20 elemental spells, 5 actives and 10 passives, specific to their class. These are capable of causing heavy damage from a distance, as well as getting their users out of complex situations, through the delicate use of their runes.

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2016-01-09/e8fb2201e14347e57d2c062f5108b927.jpg[/img]

Although this class will be available in April for everybody, starting now you too can transform yourself into a [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/438550/]Huppermage with this pack![/url] 

The Huppermage Pack includes: 
[list][*][b]Instant and permanent unlock of The Huppermage Class[/b]
[*][b]An animated Huppermage costume[/b] (It's aliiiive!): [i]Be true to your School, and let your colors fly![/i]
[*][b]The Huppermage Haven Bag[/b]: Your own Enchanted Kingdom
[*][b]A Steam-exclusive decoration[/b] to make your Huppermage's haven bag the coolest place ever: the Paravortal (Get in, Get out: It's never been easier to teleport a step!)[/list]
So, are you ready for the Huppermagic School? Just keep in mind that, although fun and learning are the primary goals of all education centers, serious injuries can occur!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DuUrM1qi_3s
[b]Please note: This pack is NOW also available in mainland France.[/b]

notes.title: Get ready for Kwismas Island!
notes.notes:
[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-12-15/f607f2bd36e1e15b52d4f63d08add823.jpg[/img]

There’s a real buzz over at the Trool Fair! Could it be the Quaquack Fishing and the Enutrof Game which are eliciting so much interest? Nope, even better! It’s a universe of magic that is opening its doors to you once again. Have you guessed it yet? Kwismas World is here again, of course!

From  December 16 (10:00 AM server time) until January 6 (10:00 AM server time), a wondrous world filled with presents awaits. You’ll be snowed under with snowball fights, Kwismas snowmonster events and other “cool” activities! That’s right, Kwismas World is open to visitors, starting now!

[h1]HERE’S WHAT’S IN STORE FOR YOU:[/h1]
[list][*]2 Dungeons (Father Kwismas's Workshop and Father Kwismas's House)
[*]7 Titles
[*]9 Haven Bag decorations
[*]1 Kwismas Set
[*]5 Consumables
[*]3 Festive Fairyworks
[*]5 Achievements
[*]6 monsters: Comman Deer, Gift Packages 1 and 2, Belva Deer, Boobytrapped Package and Father Kwismas
[*]As well as 5 costumes to win: Grumpy Elf, Happy Elf, Shy Elf and Crafty Elf, without forgetting the Grinch’s Costume! Speaking of which, did you know you can also fight the Grinch as the second boss of the first dungeon?![/list]
If you are the type to decorate your Kwismas tree, the inside of your home, your Bow Meow, your grandmother and even your cabinets. Luckily this is a good thing, because the Kwismas inspired Harness has just arrived! And it will make your eyes sparkle more than all the garlands of the World of Twelve together!

notes.title: Update: Back to School!
notes.notes:
Silence in class please! Sit down and get out your Huppermagic books. Because, oh yes, among other things, Update 1.45 is taking you back to school! But not just any school... Discover the wizarding contents of this magical update, which is available tomorrow, December 15!

[img] http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-12-14/e777d0cb2e5e2423c3646e72c92c98bb.jpg[/img]

When we mentioned a new class to you, you certainly couldn’t have been thinking of this! Have no fear, we won’t inflict any dull lessons with nine-figure equations on you or any that are about as informative as the story of a one-legged Bwork battling a moribund Piwi. 

The idea of becoming a mage who is able to control the elements and use runes, and work towards preserving the balance of the Krosmoz, is rather appealing, isn’t it? Well, that has now become possible, thanks to the Huppermagic School which allows you to learn new skills and opens up new quests to you, as well as a new dungeon! This time you certainly won’t have to be dragged to school, kicking and screaming! So if you want to breeze through some amazing new skills, and we’re talking Quadramental Breeze here, enrol in the Huppermagic School, located on Rok Island.

As you can tell, this school marks the arrival of the Huppermages. There is no doubt that the latter constitutes a turning point in the history of the World of Twelve.

Another important feature of this update is: Chapter 3 of the Quests of Nations! After exploring the ways of archeology, you must collect together the 3 keys to the door of the Submerged Temple of Sufokia. Your adventure begins, or rather continues, in the Kara region, in Bonta, where you will try to enter the Immaterial University of Bonta.

So join us on December 15 for the most studious update yet! Till then, make sure you revise properly!

notes.title: The Advent Calendar is coming!
notes.notes:
Twenty-five days until Christmas, and twenty-five presents to win! The Advent Calendar is back again, and by a lucky coincidence, it begins today!

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/ankama/cms/images/273/2015/11/30/444958.jpg[/img]

There’s a lot more at stake than five gold rings. The time has come to try your luck at winning the lottery! But if you think you just need to scratch a few boxes to land yourself a miraculous prize, then you’d better pinch yourself and wake up. You must first of all solve puzzles... which will lead you to the final surprise!
 
To enter the game, you must fulfil one of the following two conditions:
 [list][*]To have either made a purchase (Ogrines or items) from the Shop between January 1st 2015 and November 30th 2015.
[*]Or up until and including December 25th (during the 2015 year): to have active Booster Pack Days or have made a purchase of Booster Pack Days.[/list]
Then the Advent Calendar will only be a mouse click away, on the link below starting today around 10 AM GMT / 5 AM EST / 2 AM PST: http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/advent-calendar

notes.title: A new class is coming to the game!
notes.notes:
The mysteries around the statue in Incarnam are beginning to take shape. It’s finally time to dispel all of the mystery surrounding this strange character and it’s… form. The statue is none other than the representation of… the new class coming to WAKFU: the Huppermages!

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-11-18/5efce221cf060292321e7474f7b143da.png[/img]

While Ogrest’s Chaos was in full swing on the surface of the World of Twelve, the Huppermages decided to leave in order to save their school. Shortly after they fled, the heart of their very island exploded and, despite all their efforts and sacrifices to save their inherited knowledge, the island crashed beneath the ocean, half submerged between sky and sea. With the world today slowly stabilizing, the Huppermages have reappeared!
 
So, why this sudden disappearance? What of the famed Huppermage School? And just who are these Huppermages anyway? What do they want? We will reveal all of their secrets in the coming weeks… starting with the Huppermage School (in a devblog coming soon!)

[h1]How can you access this new class?[/h1]

As with some of the new classes coming to the World of Twelve, we will unlock access to the Huppermages in [b]several steps.[/b]

[h1]An early access...[/h1]

In France, this new class will have a special relation to the DOFUS - Book 1: Julith movie. As such, it will be made available during preview screenings, contests, and other special events tied to the movie.
 
As for an international preview access, we are still working on ways for you to get your hands on it that would be both special and original. We're not forgetting you and we'll keep you updated very soon...

[h1]...and then all-round access![/h1]

Eventually, all players will be able to play the new class without any condition, like with any other character class.

This is just the first news regarding the new WAKFU character class, there will be more to come. And to reassure you, we will not wait for the movie to be screened in a theater near you to let you win an opportunity to play this new class in early access.

But first, a question: do you want to play a [b]Huppermage?[/b] (Below is a sneak peek of how the Huppermage class will look, males will be revealed soon!)

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-11-18/89fd777adf7b1c35bb1a00b5c04f8335.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Krosmaster Arena is now online!
notes.notes:
The Demons of the Hours says playtime is over! They had their fun with the beta, but now they want to see some real fierce battles! If that’s what they want... indulge them! [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/329790][b]Krosmaster Arena[/b][/url] is now online, for XXIII’s sake, get playing now!

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/ankama/cms/images/273/2015/10/27/444101.jpg[/img]

There are more than 130 virtual figurines, so you can play your favorite heroes, plus 4 game modes (including PvE, PvP, and International Tournament) so you can fully develop your potential. Challenge yourself with Krosmaster Arena online!
 
Krosmasters of the world, it’s time to challenge each other, or rather the six worlds! You’ll now be able to prove your strategic prowess in Astrub, Frigost, Brakmar, Moon, Forfut, and the Xelorium! Six worlds with six levels each: your fighters will see 36 candles!
 
Good timing too, since the new season of ranked match mode is starting today! Something to warm up with before you throw your hat in the ring. Awaiting for you in the next updates are LeChouque, Darkli Moon, and Grougaloragran!
 
It’s the beginning of a new era for Krosmaster Arena, so don’t miss it! 
 
Still not sure? Every Monday, 5 virtual figurines will be available for free during a test week on the krosmaster.com site!
 
One last thing before you head off into battle, the tablet version keeps getting better and will soon reach a whole new level!

While you wait, take your neurons for a ride and... become master of the Krosmoz!
 
Krosmaster Arena online is also available on Steam here: http://store.steampowered.com/app/329790

notes.title: Al Howin: The Curse of the Pumpkwin!
notes.notes:
While all prepare for the celebration of Al Howin as expected, dark powers work in the shadows and threaten the safety of the World of Twelve. In taverns, a word jumps from lips to lips without ever being said out loud: curse. And anxiety grows while a feared date approaches: [b]October 28th...[/b]

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/ankama/cms/images/273/2014/10/27/425637.jpg[/img]

To be honest, Al Howin wouldn’t really be Al Howin without one of these old curses! This year, from [b]October 28th to November 11th[/b], participate in our exclusive event and hunt down the trouble makers in the World of Twelve; and above all, the one that started it all: a dreadful Witch!

For this 2015 vintage, Al Howin offers you:

A [b]unique quest[/b] setting you on the trails of the Witch, including:
[list][*]An [b]exclusive dungeon[/b] available in Astrub for the duration of the event
[*]A legion of [b]Cursed Gobballs.[/b]
[*]Villagers with unusual appearance, the [b]“Pumpkwinner”[/b]
[*]Almokens to win.[/list]

Rewards to unlock in the game:
[list][*]3 achievements linked to the Al Howin quest
[*]2 Insignias
[*]6 items in the theme of Al Howin
[*]2 exclusive titles
[*]2 Haven-Bag decorations[/list]

As you can see, this year, it’s time to get down to business! You have a curse to fight, a witch to educate, and a lot of Pumpkins to turn into soup! But don’t worry: once the threat is dealt with, you’ll have time to celebrate with a lot of costumes and sweets!

See you on [b]October 28th[/b] and get ready to be-witched!

notes.title: Anathar Pack on Steam
notes.notes:
Now there goes a Shushu with an impressive CV. He invaded the World of Twelve, and then got locked up by the Justice family, before stealing the power of creating portals from Yugo. “He” is Anathar, one the most feared Shushus in the World of Twelve! Find him from today onwards in a pack that’s pretty impressive as well, and is available on Steam and in the Shop!

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-10-23/e2775f5257544510bdc7622170a41a67.jpg[/img]

You can’t shoo away this Shushu! You may well have made his acquaintance in season 2 of WAKFU, the animated series*. An encounter which Yugo and his friends could have happily done without... You have to admit though, capturing the most dangerous Shushu after Rushu does take a lot of guts! And he had to be handled with kid gloves, because this dude actually has the power to copy the abilities of any who dare touch him! Which has put more than one brave adventurer off approaching him...
​
The commander-in-chief of Rushu’s armies has arrived on Steam and in your Shop! For the price of 80 euros, the Anathar pack contains everything a player needs to level up quickly and easily in game. Judge for yourself:
  
[list][*]90 days - booster pack
[*]Vampire Costume
[*]Flame & Cloud Knights
[*]Phoenix (Golden pet : +30% dmg and +60HP at level 50)
[*]Super Growth Kibble (level-up your pet or mountpet at the maximum level)
[*]"King Kong" Super Emote
[*]Gobball War Chief (make your choice!)
[*]Krosmoz Harness
[*]Shushu Bedroom Set
[*]25 Vital Energy Cocktails - that fill up your life at the end of combat!
[*]Shushu Haven Bag Kit
[*]Change Class Scroll - level 1 to 200
[*]Exclusive decoration.[/list]

You’ll also get to stand out from other players thanks to the numerous customization items it contains!
If you want to make the most of this offer, go on Steam or to the Shop right now!

[i]*Season 2, episode 8: "The Justice Knight" is also available on Netflix![/i]

notes.title: Nation Quests: The Second Chapter
notes.notes:
Remember, a few months back, the [b]Quest of Nations[/b] gave you the chance of becoming a legendary hero. Today, the adventure continues with [b]Chapter 2: The Archaeologists and the Buried Temple![/b]

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-10-22/cf0dbb449402f998f128253e95164a6d.jpg[/img]

Previously in the Quest of Nations...

After having explored up, down and along the shores of the island of Mount Zinit, you end up going in circles. A divine artifact is what’s missing in order for you to reach the entrance to Ogrest’s lair! No sooner said than done – off you go in search of it! But… huh… in search of what, actually? Well yeah, you can’t look for something if you don’t know what you’re looking for!

Fortunately, you’ve been able to rely on the wise counsel of good ole Pappy Pal and it wasn’t long before you found out that the artifact in question was nothing less than a... dragon! That’s all?! For a minute you were worried...

Chapter 2 of the Quest of Nations takes you on the path of archeology, and it’s a branch of archeology that specializes in the period prior to or during Ogrest's Chaos. But before you embark on this quest, you first have to prove yourself! Because the fragile archeological sites around the World of Twelve will hardly welcome in adventurers with all the finesse of a war Gobball... And who knows? Perhaps you will discover a hidden passion for antique ruins! Plumb the depths of the World of Twelve before making your way to the top of its highest peak, on Mount Zinit!

There, you will encounter both the best of friends and the worst of enemies, such as Team Missile, whose screensaver you can find here: http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/media/wallpapers/443975-team-missile

notes.title: Moon Island: Coming 29th of September!
notes.notes:
Can you hear it? No, it’s not the beat of a tomtom sounding through the mountain passes... Nor the heavy pace of a hunting Crackler... It is the sound of a proud Moon, beating his chest to announce to one and all that he is back!

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/ankama/cms/images/273/2015/09/21/443264.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW ZONE: MOON ISLAND[/h1]

The news winged its way across sea and ocean with the speed of an Albatrocious. Although I wasn’t there, he said I was his friend. Which came as some surprise, I spoke into his eyes. “I thought you died alone, a long, long time ago?” “Oh no, not me. I never lost control. You’re face to face, with the Moon who sold the World - of Twelve!” No need to mince words with long speeches, Moon’s back with reinforcements and some strong reasons to return:

[list][*]Level 200 unlock
[*]2 new monster families: the Tropikokos and the Kanniballs
[*]2 new dungeons: the Tropike Dungeon and the Kanniball Dungeon
[*]10 new resources to be harvested: two for each gathering profession
[*]58 new items to find, including:
- 1 Relic
- 2 Epic Items
- 4 Sets
- 15 items to craft
[*]2 new Archmonsters: Besides the usual daily quests, a team of psyched Otomai's Disciples is offering you the chance to battle two new Archmonsters, in a completely new, communal way! 
[*]8 new high-level runes (170+): Exquisite Runes, runes with simple bonuses (melee, ranged, single-target and AoE damage) and other brand new bonuses (MP, range etc). 
[*]Crafting recipes from loot drops after defeating monsters, crafting items, tokens or kamas as well.
[*]Bosses with scalable difficulty based on a new mechanic.[/list]

At a bend in the road, you might even meet Moon in the flesh - or fur, more like!

[h1]HEROES SYSTEM[/h1]

You’ve been looking forward to it... And here it is! The system known as “The Heroes System,” the biggest feature in this update, allows you to play using up to 3 characters from your account. Just imagine the strategic possibilities this new system offers you, let alone the rewards in terms of your group’s ranking. 

[h1]QUEST OF NATIONS: CHAPTER 2[/h1]

Following on directly from the first chapter, you have now arrived in the heart of your nation. We’ll let you find out what happens next in game! Ciao!

What, you want to know more? Hmm... Now really, is that fair? Oh, alright then! To give you an idea of what’s waiting for you, here’s a few search terms: [b]searches, temples, archaeology and... “Dr Jones”![/b] 

[h1]ERGONOMIC IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]

There have been over 30 ergonomic improvements, including:
[*]Feed pets with a single click.
[*]No longer dying at the end of battle if your companion(s) are still alive.
[*]Add some non-usable items to the shortcut bar (Resources for example).
[*]Animation optimization.
[*]And more![/list]
You can read the full changelog here: http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/patch-notes/443421-this-island-moon

You can experience it for yourself ingame on the 29th of September... but while you wait, watch our teaser trailer below!

https://youtu.be/NNz6aLTooIg

notes.title: Introducing the... Krosmoz Harness!
notes.notes:
This summer, like every summer, an unquenchable thirst for adventure has taken hold of you. But what if instead of setting off in search of adventure, this time you let the adventure come to you? Non-stop travels await you with the Krosmoz Harness! Available in the shop for 3,500 Ogrines, it’s definitely out of this world!

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-08-17/40855a803d9cbe18aef782b7790300eb.jpg[/img]

Have you been dreaming of an intergalactically renowned harness? A harness that makes you feel like you’re traveling through dimensions every time you get on your Gobball War Chief mount? A harness whose style knows no limits and is beloved from the highest realms of Ingloriom to the infamous depths of the Shustuft Crust?
 
Well, wake up, because that dream just got real!
 
The Krosmoz Harness arrives in your shop today and is available for 3,500 Ogrines. For the most enthusiastic adventurers among you, a pack containing the Krosmoz Harness and the Gobball War Chief mount will also be available for four days in the shop for 8,000 Ogrines.
 
Equipped on your Gobball War Chief mount, this harness in the colors of the Krosmoz will take you further than ever before!
 
Please note that the harness is linked to the account of the player who owns it. It cannot be exchanged or sold in a Marketplace.
 
Act now and get this harness (in the [b]Official Shop[/b] and the [b]Ingame Shop[/b],) which is very...spatial, to say the least!

Equipped on your Gobball War Chief mount, this harness in the colors of the Krosmoz will take you further than ever before!
 
Please note that the harness is linked to the account of the player who owns it. It cannot be exchanged or sold in a Marketplace.
 
Act now and get this harness (in the [b]Official Shop[/b] and the [b]Ingame Shop[/b],) which is very...spatial, to say the least!

notes.title: Compensation: Forfut Frenzy Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-08-13/79d75b46d3476d80e7fc35bd4234b812.jpg[/img]

Due to the Forfut Frenzy update downtime and subsequent hotfixes, we will be offering a compensation package for Twelvians: ten days of Booster time, a costume, an emote and some growth kibbles!  On top of that, we will also have two Bonus XP Weekends to help you catch up with your adventures in the World of Twelve.

We understand that the recent update and the downtimes that followed caused disruptions to your play, so in order to compensate you we will be offering the following: 

[list][*]10 days of Booster time (for those who had an active Booster, or purchased a Booster since the 1st of June.)
[*]2 weekends of Double XP in Combat, Crafting, Kamas, and +5% Prospection bonus across all servers. The first will be on the 22nd of August (0:01 AM server time) to the 23rd of August (11:59 PM server time) and the second on 5th of September (0:01 AM server time) to the 6th of September (11:59 PM server time)
[*]Whisperer Costume
[*]Sitar Emote
[*]5 Growth Kibble[/list]

The Booster time will be applied to the applicable accounts lasting from the 21st of August to the 31st of August.  And the additional items will be sent out in batches next week, so be sure to check your gift box from time to time! 

Please accept our apologies for the downtime and disruptions to your Wakfu time!

notes.title: Third Special Episode of Wakfu now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/comm/news/wakfu/www/07_2015/en-and-es-image.jpg[/img]

The third of the trio of the WAKFU Special Episodes is here! The Quest for the Six Eliatrope Dofus - Book III: Dragon Mountain is now available in French and English (as well as Spanish subtitled version.) 

[b]Synopsis:[/b]

In this last Episode: getting back to the Sadida Kingdom, Yugo discovers that Percedal has decided to directly attack the root cause of the problem: the terrifying Ogrest. The Iop warrior has gone to Mount Zinit. To Yugo, it's obvious they must go help him, no matter the cost. 

But strangely, his brother, Adamai, doesn't agree. Did his visit to the Kingdom of the Winds disturb him? No matter! It's time for actions, not questions! Yugo has made his decision: he'll go help Percedal, with or without Adamai! The destiny of the World of Twelve is in our heroes' hands, now more than ever.

notes.title: Forfut Frenzy: Viewers Beware
notes.notes:
[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-07-07/f890a75032bfa6ddf4e54a2324883686.jpg[/img]

You’re in for a scare… For the brave, rush online for the new update is here! Visit Forfut and Astrub too, where new nation quests wait for you. And who could forget [strike]the beautiful[/strike] Brakmar, the location of a new dungeon. 

Vacations in the World of Twelve are pretty much the same in the real world. First, one needs to read up on all of the areas to visit (the itinerary) and prepare the equipment they need. For example, what are the best spells to use in that particular destination?
  
Then, you simply need to decided which activities to do first:

[list][*]Explore the streets of [b]Astrub[/b] and take an eventual hike of a nearby [b]mountain[/b] (no need to take the Drago-express, you can walk it in 15.)
[*]Take a trip on the wild side with a visit to a small, [b]gloomy island.[/b] Not for the faint-hearted.
[*]For the more adventurous… adventurers among you, visit the [b]dungeons[/b] and monuments that await you in popular locations.[/list]

And don’t forget to visit the [b]Stalagmotel[/b] in Brakmar: [b]level 52, 4 new monsters, an exclusive boss and exclusive, 5 new achievements and 12 pieces of new equipment[/b] (in case you wanted to bring a souvenir.) 
 
Forfut Island has its share of attractions too: [b]Wagnar’s Castle[/b] (Level 82) and the [b]Miseryeum[/b] (Level 77)
 
You can read the full changelog here: http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/patch-notes/437028-forfut-frenzy/

Packed for your trip? Perfect, leave immediately for the trip of lifetime: [b]Forfut Frenzy![/b]

Remember back in March, when the Black Crow donned his feathers and flew in to those who had the misfortune to cross his path. notes.title: Second Special Episode of Wakfu now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/comm/news/wakfu/www/07_2015/wakfu-oav-2-main-capsule-616x353-en-v2.jpg[/img]

Last week, we announced that the first WAKFU Special Episode would be coming to Steam. Well now we have the second just for you! [b][i]The Quest for the Six Eliatrope Dofus - Book II: Ush[/i][/b] is now available in French and English (as well as Spanish subtitled version.) 

[b]Synopsis:[/b]

In this episode, our heroes help captives in Harebourg's icy prison, and discover Joris, Kerub, and Atcham trapped in blocks of ice.  Once freed, the prisoners explain how they came into possession of the six Eliatrope Dofus, and how they lost them. The members of a mysterious brotherhood, the Forgotten Fraternity, took them. To what end? No one seems to know. But they've worked since the beginning of time to write history as they want it written... 

While Otomai and Adamai continue their quest for Dofus in the Kingdom of the Winds, Yugo joins Joris, Atcham and Kerub to explore the Ecaflip Dimension. Meanwhile, Amalia, Ruel, Percedal and his family go back to the Sadida Kingdom to save it from the rising waters...

notes.notes:
[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/comm/news/wakfu/www/06_2015/wakfu-oav1-capsule-large-v2.jpg[/img] 

We are pleased to announce that the Wakfu Animation is back with a new adventure. Previously broadcast on French television, the first of the three Special Wakfu Episodes is here! The Quest for the Six Eliatrope Dofus - Book I : The Throne of Ice is now available in French and English (as well as a Spanish subtitled version.)

[b]Synopsis:[/b]

It's already six years after our heroes saved the World of Twelve from Qilby. They've all taken the opportunity to settle down into a peaceful existence. None could imagine what awaits them. 

A strange messenger has come to inform Yugo, Adamai, Ruel, and then Percedal's family, that Princess Amalia, needs them: Ogrest is having another crying fit, which is flooding a huge part of the Sadida Kingdom. Worse still, the six Eliatrope Dofus, the only things capable of stopping him, have gone missing!

Only two of the precious eggs have been located: they're being held by the odious Count Harebourg, lord of Frigost Island. He's agreed to give them back in exchange for Amalia's hand in marriage. Ready to do anything to save her people, Amalia accepts his offer and the entire Brotherhood accompanies her to Frigost.

We are pleased to announce that the Wakfu Animation is back with a new adventure. Previously broadcast on French television, the first of the three Special Wakfu Episodes is here! The Quest for the Six Eliatrope Dofus - Book I : The Throne of Ice is now available in French and English (as well as a Spanish subtitled version.)

[b]Synopsis:[/b]

It's already six years after our heroes saved the World of Twelve from Qilby. They've all taken the opportunity to settle down into a peaceful existence. None could imagine what awaits them. 

A strange messenger has come to inform Yugo, Adamai, Ruel, and then Percedal's family, that Princess Amalia, needs them: Ogrest is having another crying fit, which is flooding a huge part of the Sadida Kingdom. Worse still, the six Eliatrope Dofus, the only things capable of stopping him, have gone missing!

Only two of the precious eggs have been located: they're being held by the odious Count Harebourg, lord of Frigost Island. He's agreed to give them back in exchange for Amalia's hand in marriage. Ready to do anything to save her people, Amalia accepts his offer and the entire Brotherhood accompanies her to Frigost.

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/367910/]Click here to visit the pages of the first Special Wakfu Episode.[/url]

notes.title: Event: A Shower of Bonuses!
notes.notes:
This weekend, get ready for a double dip in additional XP! We’ll be offering a bonus of 50% for Kamas, Crafting and Combat XP for all Twelvians throughout the World of Twelve!

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-06-10/820996589b8abdec74f764538bfa7129.jpeg[/img]

Blou is the Meridia of Humidity. Where Blou passes, water is not far behind, and usually where it is least expected, and that usually brings all sorts of water-borne beasts. Be very careful--what looks like an oasis may hold more dangers than you’re ready for!

Yaka is the Meridia of Industry, and for Yaka, nothing is impossible! At least as long as you know your way around a workbench. Take the most mundane of items, and put them to new, more exciting uses. Everything is possible with Yaka, and it’s awesome!  

From Saturday the 13th of June (0:01 AM server time) until Sunday the 14th of June (11:59 PM server time) stalwart adventurers will earn +50% Kamas, Combat (in the dungeons listed below) and Crafting XP on all servers.

[list][*]Celestial Prairies (Level 34)
[*]Dirty Trouffe Estate (Level 43)
[*]Dark Hurl Docks (Level 58)
[*]Lunar Altar (Level 63)
[*]Temple of the Grand Orrok (Level 72)
[*]Mussly Hammam (Level 88)
[*]Dancehall Arena (Level 92)
[*]Yech'ti'Wawa's Kennel (Level 100)
[*]Ambassador's Wing (Level 108)

notes.title: Ankamerica Tour 2015: Anime Expo and Cosplay Competition
notes.notes:
[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-06-09/324e5f95d4adb7504d34538904b2c0d5.jpg[/img]

To all Word of Twelve inhabitants! WAKFU will be visiting... Anime Expo!

We were very happy to have been present at Anime Expo last year for a screening and a presentation panel and are even more thrilled to announce that not only we will get to do them again, but also we will be present at our booth during the whole convention to welcome our visitors! Which is why we want to make sure to spread the word to our Community, especially if you are already planning on attending!

Anime Expo’s doors will be open from 12:00 PM PST – 6:00 PM PST on July the 2nd and 10:00 AM PST – 6:00 PM PST daily from July the 3rd until July the 5th included.

HEY! Before we forget... are you a Cosplay fan? Ankama is proud to announce its very first Ankamerica Tour 2015 Cosplay Contest! This Cosplay contest is a chance for your craftsmanship to be shown and rewarded with awesome prizes; the experience will be complete with a pre-judging session and a catwalk display at Anime Expo in Los Angeles, USA!

You can find all the details by visiting our official site here: http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/announcements/435765-ankamerica-tour-2015-cosplay-contest

notes.title: Nation Quests: The First Chapter
notes.notes:
[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/ankama/cms/images/273/2015/06/05/435722.jpg[/img]

The main quest that begins in Astrub will be extending to the nations! Become a recognized hero from all corners of the World of Twelve by completing the Nations Quests. Embark on a journey where you will claim a new artifact that will make you more than a hero of just legends!

If you’re a perceptive adventurer, you might understand that the Nation Quests will re-open the door to Mount Zinit, where Ogrest awaits. Cut into five chapters, these quests will have you explore the nations of the World of Twelve and quench your thirst for glory by allowing you to reach the first level of Mount Zinit.

To be eligible for the post of "legend of the hero", you will need to collect all the divine artifacts scattered around the World of Twelve. These will enable you to reach the next stage of Mont Zinit. But later, let’s not get ahead of ourselves…

Start the quest series with the first chapter, beginning in Astrub. You will meet several famous figures along your journey, but above all, Ullu, the messenger of the gods, who will invite you to join him in the lair of Ogrest...

The first series of quests will be waiting for you on the 7th of July in Astrub! Embark on a solo adventure and discover a dungeon owned by a cult who worship Ogrest and be ready to fight!
 
Good luck! 

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-06-05/b8448ae7fd61cbb7c854d25c23966d9e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The WAKFU universe is coming to mobile gaming!
notes.notes:
Twelvians, we are proud to present an all new adventure! Meet WAKFU Raiders, an RPG for your smartphone/tablet that allows you to recruit powerful warriors to fight on your behalf as you investigate the anomalies of a parallel world... [url=http://www.wakfu.com/en/more-wakfu/wakfu-raiders]Pre-register now to get a gift![/url]

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-06-01/709f0d4c858ef0118d1817311c06ef88.jpg[/img]

With 30 collectable characters and hundreds of quests to complete, WAKFU Raiders is another chapter in the transmedia saga of the WAKFU universe that brings you a new story and new gameplay! Explore uncharted territories in the World of Twelve! You’ll need the perfect team to battle all those who dare to cross your path and to outsmart the many mysteries you’ll uncover.
 
This new game, which links dynamic combat with a frenetic rhythm, was developed by Gumi for the iOS and Android platforms. [url=http://www.wakfu.com/en/more-wakfu/wakfu-raiders]Pre-registration begins today[/url], and if you register now, you’ll get an exclusive item on the day of release. 
 
If you pre-register, you’ll be ready to discover all of the secrets of WAKFU Raiders at the end of June! In the meantime, learn more about Ankama’s upcoming mobile and tablet games, including WAKFU Raiders, by liking our new Facebook page: [url=https://www.facebook.com/AnkamaMobile]Ankama Mobile.[/url]
 
 Will your skills behind your computer screen give you the edge in the cutthroat world of smartphones and tablets? Only time will tell!

notes.title: Devblog: Spell System Revamp
notes.notes:
Much more than an optimization, the spell system is going to undergo a revamp that will spice up your fights and allow you to use some real strategy. By establishing a “deck” principle for active and passive spells, choice will once again be a central element in combat, making it possible to select weapons depending on the opponent!

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-05-20/f36015153121557b3b3690d8a8f0f4b2.jpg[/img]

While we’re waiting for the WAKFU beta test tomorrow, here’s a preview of the spell system revamp for you.
Several reasons lie behind these changes, the chief of them being that the current spell system was based on 100 levels. At level 175, several issues became obvious, namely, the absence of player choice. Furthermore, having active spells spread over ten levels and passive spells spread over twenty levels created far too many restrictions for no real reason.
 
We have therefore decided to make changes to the system by reintroducing the concept of choice, by implementing active and passive spells across fewer levels and by rewarding the player with power spikes for unlocks (of spells, passive spells, “slots,” etc).

[h1]Decks[/h1]

This is a set of spells and passive spells that you select at the beginning of a battle depending on who your opponent is. It will replace the old system and... will change everything! Effectively, it lets you put your strategy in place through the management of your spells and passive spells. Even so, there are still some rules:

[list][*]You must have added a spell to your deck before you can use it in battle.
[*]You must have added a passive spell to your deck before you can use it in battle.
[*]You can change the spells in your deck at any time, except in combat![/list]

[h1]Active and Passive Spells[/h1]

In the past, active and passive spells used to span several levels. We have removed the part where you had to build up your active and passive spells at each level with points.
From now on, active spells have only one level. As for passive spells, these will have only one or two levels.
 
Each active and passive spell is unlocked at a specific character level and passive spells level up by themselves at certain character levels. Here’s an example: a passive spell that is unlocked at level 20 and adds +60 Dodge would level up automatically at level 120 and would add +180 Dodge.
 
All of these unlocks take place as a character levels up, from level 1 to level 200.

[h1]Elemental Spells[/h1]

These have also undergone some significant changes. We increased the number of playable elemental spells by increasing the XP attributed to spells. For reference purposes, we began with a base of 5 elemental spells at level 1, increasing up to a total of 10 elemental spells at level 200. At the same time, we removed the limitation that meant a single-element character had less playable spells than a multi-element character, which has no purpose in this new system.
 
We also decided to replace the “spell lock” (padlock) system at level 100. The reason for changing this is to make this one of the level 100+ rewards, allowing players to easily alter their builds as they so wish.
In actual fact, all the changes made to this element in the previous patch mean it’s now quicker to decrease a spell’s level in favor of others if players want to change direction.

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-05-21/4f8959a236739c0fbc62949d922cf5aa.png[/img]

[h1]F.A.Q[/h1]

[h1]How do you add spells or passive spells to a deck?[/h1]

Simply open the deck management page (the default shortcut for this is S), which is about to replace the old spell interface. When you’re in the interface, you have two ways of adding a spell:

[list][*][b]Click on an empty spell slot[/b], which opens up the spell page, then select the spell you want.
[*][b]Click on the spell tab[/b], which opens up the spell page (which looks like the current interface). You can then drag and drop the selected spells into the empty slots.[/list]
 
Tip for pros: You can also drag and drop spells from one deck to another to swap spells!

Spells you add to your deck will appear in exactly the same order in your spell bar.
 
This will work in exactly the same way for passive spells, but via the passive spell page.

[h1]How many spells and passive spells can I put in my deck?[/h1]

The number of spell and passive spell “slots” that are available will increase with character level.

We haven’t yet decided at which levels each spell and passive spell slot will unlock, but we can already tell you that at level 200–which will soon be unlocked–you’ll have up to 12 spell slots and 6 passive spell slots.

[h1]You mention 'spells' and 'passive spells,' but what's the deal with 'elemental spells' and 'active spells?'[/h1]

The new active spells will be pretty nearly as strong as your old active spells at max level. The new passive spells are different than the old ones. We removed some of their bonuses, but we also separated them out into different passive spells, and we added quite a few new ones at the same time.

Among these new passive spells, some are “simple” characteristic bonuses, some are game mechanic-based–either existing or new–and the others are spell modifiers. The latter will change how a spell works, either to make it better or just different.

The new way this works has enabled us to create more clear-cut builds for characters, with greater emphasis on character speciality preferences.

[h1]It’s great that you’re increasing the number of elemental spells! But isn’t that going to be a bit too much?[/h1]

Uh, no, since the limit on how many spells are actually playable is already managed by the deck system. In any case, even after players have reached the max level–whether it be level 200 or the current max level–they’ll continue to gain spell XP and, with a lot of effort, they’ll be able to acquire every elemental spell at maximum level.

notes.title: A Blood-Curdling Update!
notes.notes:
Here, it’s always night. The only other sound besides the creaking of dead trees and the icy wind is the flap-flap of bats flying through the air. As lightning rips through the sky, you see it: Vampyro Dungeon. Be afraid, Adventurers! Be very afraid! That proves that you’re still alive... [b]Find out about the next update coming in June![/b]

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-05-15/5e2af6d4dbc8019d5e96e1ccbac6d8d5.jpg[/img]

You’ll have figured out by now that you’re on Forfut Island, where the sun never rises and the Ghouls are quite stupid. But it’s not just the island that’s out for your blood... This update will see the addition of two new dungeons, teeming with vermin that are already licking their lips in anticipation of your visit.
 
Alright, enough with the suspense. Here’s what you’ve been waiting for!

[h1]New Dungeon: The Misoleum, in Forfut (name is not yet final!)[/h1]
They are the subject of many nursery rhymes told to scare the children. When you have to face them, you’ll want to call your mommy too. Meet the [b]Bogey-Monsters[/b] (name is not yet final), a new family of monsters in the most frightening of dungeons! Level: 77

[h1]New Dungeon: The Stalagmotel, in the Sidimote Moors of Brakmar[/h1]
[list][*]Four new members of the Stalagmote family and a [b]new Boss[/b] are waiting for you in this [b]dungeon only.[/b]
[*][b]Five Achievements[/b] and a [b]Meta-Achievement.[/b]
[*][b]Twelve new pieces of equipment[/b], from rare to mythic.
[*]Level: 52[/list]

[h1]Quest of Nations: Chapter 1/5[/h1]
These new quests will guide you from one nation to the next. You’ll discover the philosophy, way of life, and specialties of each, with a new [b]divine artifact[/b] at the end of chapter 5 to boot! Plus, each chapter will give you access to a [b]Dungeon Adventure[/b] and its particular equipment!

[h1]PvP Arenas[/h1]
There will be [b]nine exclusive PvP arenas[/b], so you’ll be able to get dressed to the nines to fight in these stylish places! Positioning has been reviewed to balance combat between the two teams, now all the grids are symmetrical in these arenas with such atmospheres. These arenas will be accessible from Astrub or by taking a Zaap.

[h1]New Spell System[/h1]
The spell system will undergo not just an optimization, but a rework that will spice up your combat and let you implement a real strategy. By establishing a “deck” principle for active and passive spells, choice will once again be a central concept in combat, making it possible to select spells depending on the opponent!
 
So, are you happy now? Whoops, let’s try that again. [i]Are you scared?[/i]

notes.title: Devblog: The Flame Knight
notes.notes:
[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/ankama/cms/images/273/2015/04/29/434071.jpg[/img]

In 2015, WAKFU will see the release of the Tormentator Knights that you are no doubt familiar with from other formats (DOFUS, manga, Krosmaster, etc.). Whereas these are accessible in DOFUS via the incarnation system, in WAKFU they’ll be available as Sidekicks. The five knights, called Flame, Cloud, Drop, Leaf and Darkness, will be released throughout the year. And the first to show up will be the Flame Knight! Want to find out more about these new arrivals? 

You can find all the information here in this devblog from [Zeorus]: http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/devblog/tickets/434980-knights-devblog-flame

notes.notes:
Hey Twelvians, it’s time to tumble out of bed, stumble into the kitchen and pour yourself a cup of ambition… because we’ve got another [b]bonus XP[/b] weekend for you!

In the spirit of International Workers’ Day, we want to reward you back for all that service and devotion! Don’t let bosses hold you back, ditch those dungeons and take up hammer and anvil and get to work…
 
After all, we’ll be granting you a [b]DOUBLE Crafting XP[/b] all weekend (from [b]Friday the 1st of May (00:01 AM server time) until Sunday the 3rd of May (11:59 PM server time[/b]) throughout the entire World of Twelve on all servers.

notes.title: New Companions: The Knights!
notes.notes:
There are family histories that the World of Twelve isn't close to forgetting. That of the [b]knights[/b], sons of [b]Count Saverne[/b], is one of them. Today, they're back in the forefront. Darkness, Drop, Leaf, Cloud and Flame: what would you say to having them as sidekicks? But first, discover (or rediscover) who they are!

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-04-29/521a32f5c05b6318be22a7f211539a9c.jpg[/img]

Remember, way back in the Age of the Dofus, in [b]337: Count Saverne[/b] was devoting himself entirely to experiments on [b]Amakna's inhabitants[/b] — experiments that were, to say the least, strange and controversial. To put an end to these disgraceful acts, the [b]king of Bonta[/b] charged [b]Hissering the Handyman[/b] with putting the mad genius out of action. Which is to say: [b]Clustus Sheran Sharm[/b] wanted him caught – alive was good, dead was better!

No sooner said than done: Hissering surprised the genius in his lab, at the top of the [b]Dark Tower.[/b] What he found was rather macabre...

"The first thing I saw when I entered the room was that there were jars everywhere... at first I thought 'Wow, this guy really likes jam!', but when I got closer, then I really understood... What horror! Women...! Women in jars! All of them reported missing in Amakna! [b]I didn't dare imagine what type of experiments the dastardly Saverne was subjecting them to..."[/b]

The horrifying spectacle before him made his mind up for him - he would fix the Count for good! But what he didn't discover until afterward, with a mixture of surprise and horror, is that the late count had been the father of [b]5 little kids...[/b] Full of remorse, he decided to adopt them. Days, months, and years passed - the 4 children grew in their new home: Hissering, his wife [b]Lysse[/b] and their natural son [b]Babalu.[/b]

Everything was great. Up until the day the 5 brothers revealed their incredibly powerful elemental powers... Excited about this discovery, [b]Hissering[/b] decided to create for each of his adopted sons a weapon that could [b]amplify[/b] and [b]channel[/b] this magic: the [b]Tormentator.[/b]

Maybe you're already equipped with one of these Tormentators so you too can enjoy the powers of [b]Darkness, Drop, Leaf, Cloud[/b] and [b]Flame![/b]

The first of them in the spotlight will be [b]Flame Knight![/b] Even though his base element is fire, his powers vary depending on his equipment. Which makes him a [b]mercenary capable of adapting[/b] to any type of situation! Soon, a [b]devblog[/b] will explain the game ideas behind this new sidekick. While you wait, you can always check out Flame Knight's encyclopedia page.

Available for a free trial starting on the [b]30th of April[/b] and [b]lasting 7 days[/b], this sidekick will then be available in the shop for the price of [b]5,800 Ogrines.[/b]

Are you burning with anticipation yet?

notes.notes:
