notes.title: Steel Beak on a plate!
notes.notes:
[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-04-13/b0e43c849a74d6fc94744e4bef11a851.png[/img]

"I spit on your grave!" Booms Steel Beak, a promise that will only attract the craziest of adventurers! When the Black Crow equips his steel armour, he become the level 175 Ultimate Boss. Do you dare challenge him?
 
High upon the peaks of Kelba, on a windswept plateau, an opponent waits for you. You better take him seriously, because the only humour Steel Beak appreciates is black humour… and it may be at your expense if you think you can beat him with a poxy few spells!
 
To reach Steel Beak, you’ll have to march against the precipice of cliffs, avoid traps (by doing so, narrowly-escape lacerations) and fight the wicked Raskaws! Luckily for you, we have a preview of Steel Beak’s arsenal!
 
Review your strategy, polish your equipment, and most importantly, choose strong teammates! With less than six sharp fellows, it’ll be unlikely you’ll top this steely foe! However, if you manage to defeat him, you’ll get access to new rewards, such as the Steel Beak Set!
 
[h1]Against the clock![/h1]
 
A change of scenery, and a change of trials - no way to be bored in Kelba! Does a level 75 dungeon in 10 minutes sound tempting? Head to the Abandoned Workshop! A quest is at hand, as well as tokens to exchange in the dungeon machine. But be warned: after 10 minutes, it's the door for you! And you’ll have to try again!
 
Are you ready? If so... all hands to Kelba!

You can learn more about Steel Beak here: ][b]http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/devblog/tickets/431497-ultimate-boss-steel-beak[/b]

notes.title: Migration of Steam Accounts
notes.notes:
Please note that this is only relevant to players who were playing WAKFU on Phaeris. 

Here’s how to migrate your Steam accounts to the International community.
 
[h1]Scenario 1: I log in to WAKFU using an Ankama account (Phaeris) linked to a Steam account.[/h1]

Your Ankama account (Phaeris) will not be accessible after the migration. In order to recover your account, you need to confirm its migration by filling the form on the migration page (available on the 13th of April, 2015.)
 
[list][*]Confirm your account using your Ankama Login and password.
[*]If your login or Nickname are already taken, please choose new ones.[/list]

We will unlink your Steam account and your Ankama account (Phaeris).

If you want to link your Steam account to your new Ankama account, connect with Steam on www.wakfu.com, and choose to link your Steam account to your migrated Ankama account.

The linking will work only if your Steam account is not already used on www.wakfu.com . If you already linked it, you will see it when you will try to connect with Steam.
 
[h1]Scenario 2: I log in to WAKFU using only a Steam account and have never linked it to an Ankama account (Remington/Nox, etc.)[/h1]

If you have NEVER used your Steam account on www.wakfu.com; try to connect either via www.wakfu.com or the in-game client,  and your account will then be ready to use

The only thing left you may have to do is to choose a new nickname if yours happen to already be taken.

[h1]Scenario 3: I linked my Steam account first to my Remington/Nox account and then linked it to my Phaeris account after.[/h1]

We will merge your two accounts.

[list][*]By connecting with Steam, you will access your Remington, Nox etc. and Phaeris accounts.
[*]Your nickname will be the nickname registered for Remington, Nox etc.
[*]You will keep all your characters of Remington and Phaeris.
[*]Your Ogrines will be the sum of the ogrines of your previous accounts.[/list]
 
[h1]Scenario 4: I linked my Steam account first to my Phaeris account, then linked my Remington/Nox account after.[/h1]
 
We cannot merge your accounts, otherwise you won’t be able to access one server or the other.

You would have to send us a ticket with the following details:
[List][*]Current Ankama Nickname
[*]Name of your Highest Level Character
[*]Supply three (3) suggestions for your new Ankama login[/list]
​
You may send your tickets at http://support.ankama.com and you may start filing your tickets on as soon as the migration process has been completed.

notes.title: Phaeris server moves to the 'International Community.'
notes.notes:
[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/ankama/cms/images/282/2014/10/03/425032.jpg[/img] 

Phaeris will make its return to its original home in Ankama’s Head Office, in Roubaix, France on April 13, 2015. 

During this period, Phaeris will be inaccessible until the migration is completed on April 15, 2015. Players will be compensated for the 2 days down time once the server is back up. The package will be announced separately.

The migration will have some effects on the current Phaeris we all know and love but it is a necessary move to ensure that the quality of service offered to all players is equal, around the world. Over the past few months, the players in Phaeris have been plagued by numerous problems not found on the other servers -- random disconnects, connectivity issues and others that were reported via support channels and Ambassadors. While the move back home may not be a permanent solution to these issues, the Ankama team and Devs would be able to take a closer look at these issues and will predominantly be able to provide much better support to players in Phaeris. 

[h1]What's going to happen?[/h1]

At this point, there are no major changes to what you already experience in Phaeris except for the following:
 
[list][*]Players will have to confirm their migration through our migration page. [*]The migration page will be available on or before April 13th.
[*]The server time will now follow Paris Time (UTC +1) instead of GMT+8
[*]After the Migration, players of Phaeris will also be able to access REMINGTON. You can continue your adventure in Phaeris server or have a fresh start in Remington server.
[*]The Phaeris server item mall will now be closed. The item mall to be used will be the Remington server item mall.
[*]Players will no longer be able to purchase rental items or stat costumes. Pre-existing stat/rental costumes will be linked to account.
[*]Wakfu.asia will redirect to Wakfu.com
[*]A unified Forum. No data from the Phaeris forums will be carried over – as such, we suggest that players back up their favorite guides and posts, so they can be reposted if required.[/list]

[h1]What do I need to do?[/h1]
Certain data will not be carried over to the new Phaeris; this includes the
[list][*]Forums - your name, rank, any content in the forums will be removed
[*]Ankabox - messages will be deleted
[*]Pending Gifts will be removed. Claim them before the migration, or they will be lost.
[*]Confirm your migration via our Migration page (which will be available soon).[/list]

It is recommended to all players to backup any forum posts, Ankabox messages they want to keep, and claim any pending gifts prior to the migration as they will be deleted. Once this is complete, head over to the Migration Page to confirm the migration of your account and you’re done! 
 
[h1]Steam and LikeVN Users[/h1]
A separate guide for Steam and LikeVN users will be provided soon.
 
DLC packs for the APAC community can no longer be purchased and will be available again on April the 15th, 2015 after the migration.

We would like to apologize in advance for any inconvenience caused. We sincerely hope that this move will improve your experience of Wakfu and help us serve you better. Thank you for all your support.

notes.title: Fleaster: Get those Eggs!
notes.notes:
[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-03-30/c471a9fb8c3e2cf0b1d37a3e0d1f86dc.jpg[/img]

From March the 31st at 10 AM until April the 14th at 10 AM (server time), get ready to collect eggs and participate in the hunt of your life! Or the opposite... But remember that date because Fleaster is coming back and it will be for players of all levels to enjoy!

Each year, when the first spring buds begin to bloom, the same story repeats itself: the Fleasters are overtaken by a sudden frenzy and begin to lay eggs everywhere! So be careful with where you step if you do not want to end up feeling like walking on eggshells! You don’t want to make Etnop sad or angry...
 
Indeed, it may well be that the egg Meridia is getting overwhelmed and is in need of a helping hand or two. Don’t you hear his cries for help? We sure do, so collect the Fleaster eggs by farming them, and then take them to the machine, located in the city of Astrub, to choose your reward!

Are you ready to live up to the challenge?

notes.title: Climb Kelba's Peaks
notes.notes:
[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-04-02/574820e05a80374ec56e778e155cab1b.jpg[/img]

Epic peaks and darkened rage! Your old enemy, the Black Crow is taunting you from the peaks of Kelba. How long can you handle this? Not forever: only the amount of time necessary to get your hands on what was stolen from you with his help... And it starts at 10:00 AM server time... today!

The second part of the game update "All hands to Kelba" is open! On the other side of the bridge awaits the continuation of your quest in the heart of "Kelba’s Peaks." 

First step: your appointment with your very temporary ally Kabroc. You will need him to face the Rascaws. Will you be convincing enough to get him to bend to your will?
 
Having an ally does not necessarily means having a friend! When the time comes to settle old scores, climb the peaks of Kelba to find Black Crow’s Antechamber and confront this level 100 Boss!
 
If you get there, then consider visiting Kelba and discover its hidden places:
 
[list][*]A new level 90 dungeon
[*]Otomai quests
[*]Merceneray Posts[/list]
 
Not to mention a special surprise reserved for the particularly curious adventurers:

- A Black Crow Harness that will reward those who have completed all the quests and all the acheivements of the zone... And of course defeated the sinister bird!

notes.title: Release the War Gobballs!
notes.notes:
[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-03-16/ee1be0599c32e905bd694d99b21fcd4b.jpg[/img]

The beast’s monstrous snout drips with ichor… his harness gleams in the moonlight light… his eyes sparkle with a strange light. And then his entire body rumbles, his enormous maw releases a threatening roar throughout the World of Twelve! 

[b]The War Gobball has arrived in the Shop![/b]

When it gallops, the War Gobball leaves only smoldering hoofprints in the ground! This infernal breed of Gobball will shake the ground – and scare your enemies!
 
With this new petsmount, go on an all-out assault across the wilds of the World of Twelve islands. Don’t let anybody stop you in your path, every moor, meadow… and hill will be yours to explore! The War Gobball is not only a loyal steed, but a badass too. You’ll be a true the master of Bwork'n’Roll with one of these by your side.

More information can be found here: http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/announcements/430850-gobballs-released

notes.title: Update: All hands to Kelba!
notes.notes:
[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/ankama/cms/images/282/2015/03/16/430624.jpg[/img]

The sinister cries of crows echo out in the distance; the resolute peddlers and traders welcome you… to the land of Kelba! But be wary, keep an eye on your possessions, for this land may not be as tranquil as it looks. Up there, perched high, a strange bird watches you… 

It’s here, the update is finally online! Explore the new and revamped island of Kelba, resembling a distinct similarity to the Kelba of the Wakfu, Animated Series.  The Black Crow is waiting and watching. So set foot and discover everything the merchants, and the island, have to offer!

The update includes:
[list][*]A new main quest.
[*]The addition of the Otomai Disciples and mercenary camps.
[*]The War Gobball mounts.
[*]And a new story to follow…[/list]
You can view the changelog here: http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/patch-notes/430614-all-hands-kelba
 
We want to hear what you have to say about Kelba on the forums!
 
…But tread carefully in this land of Kelba... because he lurks in the shadows, he caws from within the clouds: the terrible… Black Crow!

notes.title: Happy Birthday WAKFU!
notes.notes:
Were you there in those early days? These past three years? It was back when the World of Twelve was reborn after Ogrest’s Chaos: the WAKFU era! And it isn’t solely an MMO, we have WAKFU comics, manga, anime series and toys. To all of those who journey with us, we want to thank you. Celebrate this weekend with a bounty of gifts! 

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-02-20/dd43d9607b80aae12de306550819c51d.jpg[/img]

[h1]The memories...[/h1]

From creation to redesign, Astrub to the Divine Dimensions, Iops to Eliotropes, WAKFU has never stopped trying to seduce and surprise you… but, also, meet your needs! WAKFU exists within the transmedia universe of the Krosmoz. At the end of the year, a few special events marked these last three years: the release of the three special Wakfu series episodes, the third volume of the manga and new figurines in Krosmaster!

And our teams are working hard to continue to offer you hours of escape and excitement! So, despite the Anniversary calendar ending yesterday, the fun continues!

[h1]And the surprises![/h1]

We can’t celebrate WAKFU’s Anniversary without a plethora of gifts! Here’s what’s still in store: 

[b]Double XP Weekend![/b]
From [b]Saturday the 28th of February (00:01 AM) to Sunday the 1st of March (11:59 PM server time)[/b], there will be [b]double Combat XP, Crafting XP and Kamas[/b] for all Twelvians on Nox, Remington and Amara!

[b]Date of the Update: Revealed![/b]
The date of our next patch is something we know you’ve eagerly been waiting for! We can proudly announce that it will be on Tuesday the 17th of March. See you in game… but until then, prepare your party hats and confetti because it’s the WAKFU anniversary! 

[b]WAKFU Series: 2 FREE episodes![/b]
For the next few days, immerse yourself in the adventures of the Tofu Brotherhood with the first two episodes of WAKFU season one. Watch them for free: 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0hsm5LVIRzg
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fq_aSsC4xRA

notes.title: Event: Spring Has Sprung
notes.notes:
[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-02-11/bcfdb359fd11c10849d65a551f930e85.jpg[/img]

Celebrating spring in the middle of February!? No, we have not lost our minds, nor have we drunk too much of that... icky fermented bamboo milk! We are, actually referring to the Chinese New Year which celebrates the arrival of the first buds of Spring (on tree branches or on Bwork faces). In honour of this, we have a special event for you, starting from the [b]12th of February to the 12th of March.[/b]

...who could have guessed that the WAKFU sewers could smell like flowers?

For about three weeks, a strange, mysterious and threatening aroma will spread through the streets of Astrub, ending up in the subterranean depths of the city...

Watch as Astrub is invaded by strange masked characters, garbed in red!  It has been told that they may have a link with the Cult of Ogrest and they are known to hide in the sewers of the city... Will you have the courage to dive into this obscure pit and put a stop to their nefarious operations?

On the menu for this special event:

- A main in-game quest
- Achievements
- Customization Accessories

...And also red Gobballs!
 
It is now up to you to discover the secret of the Occult Cult!

notes.title: Hardcore: Robowl the Manipulator
notes.notes:
[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/ankama/cms/images/273/2015/01/28/429561.jpg[/img]

Have you discovered all of Xelorium’s secrets yet? Well think again, because now a new challenge awaits you! You must once again face the terrible Robowl! Wait… a minute! This isn’t the one you’re familiar with. This time it’s [b]Robowl the Manipulator![/b] You better bring reinforcements!

Robowl, the guardian of the [b]Ow El Archives[/b], is waiting for you in its hardcore version!
 
Warning to all adventurers: confronting this creature is reserved for knowledgeable ones only! 

But don't be disappointed! The harder it is to defeat, the greater the reward will be! Fortunately, unlike your last visit, you’ll now be accompanied by new friends!
 
This won’t be a walk in the park, be prepared and rally up a group of loyal allies – else you might find yourself down in the dirt, eating Downy Dandelions by their roots!
 
There’s only one last thing for us to do, which is… to wish you the best of Ecaflip’s luck (you’re going to need it!)

notes.title: Xelorium: Sidekick of Choice
notes.notes:
So, if you've had the chance to explore the second area of Xelorium, you'll notice that it's time, once again,to make a big choice! Choosing a weapon, you say? No… Not quite but close... And even better! While there are two Sidekicks, in the end, there can only be one. Which will you choose?

[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-01-22/dcfe710df3716d5f24fb013b0ae19bca.jpg[/img]

Not only you will have to make a choice that will affect the outcome of your quest, but this decision will also allow you to get your hands on a new Sidekick!
 
What a great adventure! So let’s reveal the future and especially the past of these two Sidekicks:


[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-01-22/24dc6de550fd195dfad75400e855d1e5.png[/img]
[b]PANDORA[/b]
[b]Profile:[/b] Healer / Map Control
[b]Element:[/b] Air

[b]PANDORA[/b] is a well known engineer in Astrub, the creator of the Teleport of Scriptures and unique Dimensional Voyager of the World of Twelve. She conducted research in order to reactivate a strange portal in the Temple of Scriptures. She was helped by the players in this quest and she is also known as the "Explorancient!"


[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-01-22/83d39e2c7b3fab838ba69b2fb19d234c.png[/img]
[b]CHAD[/b]
[b]Profile:[/b] Damage Dealer
[b]Element:[/b] Earth

Leader of the Tethdrap gang, he helped the players to escape the Srambad militia and locate the Dimensional Voyagers. As a Sram agent of the Dark Master Wilby, [b]CHAD O'MARSY[/b] adapts to any situation easily but often favours the use of his daggers. While he isn't so quick to warm to others, he eventually begins to focus on those who might, at first, have seemed like enemies (hint hint, Pandora!)

So, who will you choose?

notes.title: Videomakers - Answer the Call!
notes.notes:
[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/comm/news/wakfu/www/12_2014/wakfulive-ng.png[/img]

The bells of the World of Twelve are ringing loud and proud, across the seas and skies. Are you constantly stealing the spotlight of the camera? [b]Fancy producing Wakfu-related videos?[/b] Well, who knows, Ankama might just support you!

[i]Ever dreamed of capturing the final touchdown of Gobbowl?[/i]

[i]How about the bread bake-off championships in Amakna?[/i]

[i]Or even down in the dungeons, capturing footage of brave heroes who dare to take on the mighty… Dragon Pig?[/i]
 
Well, ever thought about taking up the art of Livestreaming? No, we’re not talking Dekael’s Art… we’re talking film-making, the big screen – [b]MOVIES![/b] 

Here at Ankama, we’re love animation (as you’re surely aware!) That’s why, when we see fans out there creating art, stories and videos, we’re filled with a great sense of pride. [b]Nothing feels better than seeing our player’s passion for our universe materialise into art![/b]

That’s why we want to help foster that passion!

We [b]wish to support ‘Twitchers,’ Livestreamers, Youtubers and independent video-game artists[/b], giving their videos a wider reach. 

But we also want to [b]help new talent[/b] too!

So whether you’re a master of Livestreaming or a complete 'noob' with an empty Youtube account – [b]we want to see your videos about WAKFU.[/b]

For WAKFU videos that shine out from the crowd, you can guarantee that we’ll be supporting you:
 
[list][*][b]Celebrity Status:[/b] We will announce your shows on all of our official Social Media channels! 
[*]Rewards Galore:[/b] We’ll provide the best video-artists with a stock of rewards and presents that they can give out in their shows![/list]

Don’t forget to show us, we want to see them!

notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.notes:
[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2014-12-31/1ba7566e52aacea4cc64670b5a34180e.jpg[/img]

The whole Ankama team would like to wish you a great 2015! We hope that 2014 which just ended was up to your expectations and that this new year will reach even higher that the Mount Zinit itself!

Aaah you have surely experienced many things during those twelve months... Between the Divine Dimensions, the arrival of the Eliotropes, the 10 years of DOFUS, the launch of WAKFU on Netflix and on Steam, the Ankama convention, you can say that you've have seen a lot!

But rest assured, this is not all! Never change a winning team and 2015 will probably also have its share of great amazing adventures!

In any case this is what we wish for all of you, as well as a good health like an Eniripsa and great fortune like the Enutrof!

Kwismas has passed, of course, but it seems that you forgot a gift at the foot of your Kwismas tree. Yes, yes, over there, look again... Lift some branches and unwrap the trailer of an exclusive project from our Ankama Animations team: Welsh and Sheddar:

No, it is not a new restaurant, or even a kitchen web series, but an original adventure that took place in the great Krosmoz history.

Welsh and Sheddar was an animated series project, telling us the story of Welsh, a young boy forced to fight for a legacy that he did not know existed: the throne of the Kingdom of Bonta.

But you might say: "why do you say was?” (And you are right to ask the question). Well, it is because this project first launched in 2012 and has so far little chance of arriving on your screens... The "animation" department of Ankama has lots of ideas behind their graphic tablets: series, special episodes, movies, brains are always at work! However, not all projects have the chance to reach you.

Therefore we wanted to pay tribute to one of them and share with you our passion for animation and for the diversity of subjects and heroes that it allows us to create. Even if sometimes, some do not get to be completed or others may evolve and change. We hope this will make you happy to see that we are constantly working in order to present you with great stories!

Watch, enjoy and beware: this video may get you hungry… 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PK5q0oGRzTU

notes.title: Update: Children of the God-King
notes.notes:
[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/ankama/cms/images/282/2014/12/08/426935.jpg[/img]

Discover the contents of the upcoming update on the 9th of December: The Children of the God-King.

The Eliotropes will be beaming into the World of Twelve as the next and [b]sixteenth class[/b] of Wakfu!

But they won't be alone, this update will also be introducing the [b]revamped[/b] Pandawa class.

You can find the rest of the details below:

[h1]General[/h1]

[b]Restat for the Pandawa Class:[/b] Given the changes to the class with the upcoming update, a restat for spells and abilities will now be available to the Pandawa class through the previously used quest: “Restat quest system that has the class.”

Warning: for all players who already have an in process restat quest (the level 30/80 or collecting resources quests), if you are in the last stage of the quest (“I’m ready to go and see Master Kano for redistribution of my experience!”) validate this quest restat because it has the opportunity to overwrite your current quest restat quest.

If you want to enjoy your personal restat quests, we recommend that you visit the restat instance before the update. On the big day, you will have 48 hours access to a free restate spells and abilities quest. 

[h1]New Class[/h1]

[b]Eliotrope:[/b] A new class teleports into Wakfu! On the 9th of Decemeber, you can now play as the sixteenth class of the World of Twelve!

[h1]Classes[/h1]

[b]Pandawa:[/b]

Your plentiful feedback helped sculpture the class on Beta. The revamped version of the Pandawa is now on the official servers. Prepare the party and pour the bamboo milk! 

The core objectives of the revamp are:
[list][*]Earth spells can now be cast while carrying the barrel. This will help to make the game fluid and facilitate bi-element or tri-element builds with Earth, Fire and Water.	[*]Merriment and Worn-out are more dynamic with less severe penalties for Dizzy and added specialties and bonuses.	[*]Resistance removal is now faster. The stack of resistance penalties for X amount of turns was too strong so has now been reworked to be better balanced.	[*]Some spells are now easier to use with a higher focus on utility. Some spells had strong constraints not compensated by their effects, this has now changed to be better balanced.	[*]Some of the random effects of the previous Pandawa class has now been removed. For example: the 20% chance of redirecting damage to the barrel. 	[*]The Pandawa’s ability to move the location of players (via Karchamrak/Barrel Hop) has now been balanced for greater versatility.	[*]The Pandawa has better integration of its role as a secondary tank.[/list]

[list][*][b]Bombardment:[/b] When the Foggernaut launches this spell on a target located on the Foggernaut rail, the damage will no longer be applied repeatedly.[/list]

[b]All Classes:[/b]
 
[list][*][b]Diagonal Spell:[/b] Spells that have a diagonal range will now function properly again.[/list]

[h1]World[/h1]

[b]Divine Dimension:[/b]
[list][*][b]Enurado[/b]: This zone is now accessible for all players. Xelorium will now be the new early access zone.
[*][b]Xelorium[/b]: The first zone of the new Divine Dimension will be unlocked during December. You will find more information on our website shortly.[/list]

[b]Kwismas World: [/b]
[list][*][b]Kwismas is coming![/b] Check our website in a few days for all of the information![/list]

[b]Mercenary Guild: [/b]
[list][*][b]Bonta - Mercenary Kara[/b]: A quest marker has been added for the Rank 1 contract - Collector Fund.[/list]

[h1]Haven World[/h1]

[list][*][b]Remington and Nox[/b]: 6 Haven Worlds will put on auction starting Monday the 15th of December at 6 PM GMT /10 AM PST / 1 PM EST. We will give you a complete list of Haven Worlds soon.[/list]

[h1]Sidekick / Pet / Mounts[/h1]

[list][*][b]Disappearance:[/b]Different errors causing the disappearance or loss of a Sidekick, Pet or Mount are now corrected. [b]Unlink a Sidekick: [/b]When unlinking a Sidekick, other Sidekicks will no longer be temporarily unavailable.[/list]

[h1]Items[/h1]

[list][*][b]Bucket of Water[/b]: The collection of water will now increase from 10 to 100 on general wells and from 1 to 10 in Incarnam wells to help facilitate the creation of bread.[/list]

[h1]Interface[/h1]

[list][*][b]Runic Recycler:[/b] This interface will now close properly when accepting an exchange request.

notes.title: Yugo and his companions return to screens this Saturday!
notes.notes:
[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2014-11-13/72b1c0649e8e93233a009704fcbe7238.jpg[/img]

Prepare the fanfares, ready the banners, [b]Yugo and the Brotherhood of the Tofu[/b] are coming back to screens for [b]three special episodes, the first of which is airing this Saturday![/b]

notes.title: Event: Otoul's Krosword Competition
notes.notes:
[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2014-11-10/7f0c2b79ea2d370abd3d7f4520949bb4.jpg[/img]

Today is [url=http://www.krosmoz.com/en/almanax/2014-11-10]Otoul’s day![/url] 

The smart adventurers know that Otoul is the Meridia of Intelligence, known to bless infants in the World of Twelve with great boons of wisdom and intellect. 

Eager students of the World of Twelve, whether you be an enlightened Enutrof or an Iop-brained… well… Iop, ready your minds for Otoul’s secret test: the Krosword Competition!

[h1]Instructions[/h1]

The instructions are simple! Fill in the missing words of our special 'Krosword' and unlock the marked letters. These letters will form a code that can be exchanged for a very special surprise from Otoul himself!

We are giving you the [b]next 48 hours[/b] to complete the challenge without hints. If you're still struggling after that period, keep an eye on all of our Social Media pages as we will be providing some hints to help your chances in completing the challenge!

The event will end on [b]November 14th, 8 AM GMT / 3 AM EST / 12 AM PST.[/b]

[b]Find the grid and the questions here on our main event page: [url=http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/announcements/426054-event-otoul-krosword-competition]click here![/url][/b]

[h1]Disclaimer[/h1]

Feel free to help one another, but [b]please do not spoil the game by revealing the answer or sharing the code on the forums![/b]

The code can only be redeemed by the International community.

notes.title: Dathura comes to Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2014-11-13/7461466827f24d8b4330564a7de7f2be.jpg[/img]

We’re pleased to announce that the server [b]Dathura (FR) will be available on Steam on November the 13th![/b]

[b][i]But that’s not all![/i][/b]

…There will [b]no longer be a subscription-based model for Dathura.[/b]

We received a mountain of requests (nearly as tall as Mount Zinit) to make this possible and we’re pleased to say that [b]those requests have been heard.[/b]

All of this could not be possible without you, our Steam community. Because of the immense success of our Steam launch for the International WAKFU servers, we are confident that we can share an equal level of success for our communities on Dathura.

It’s a great moment for WAKFU and we would like to thank everyone who has supported us across Steam so far; [b]the World of Twelve is lucky to have you![/b]
 
[i]Please note that Aerafal will still retain the subscription-based model and these new changes only apply to Dathura. [b]Players on the French communities who log in via Steam will only be able to select Dathura from the server list.[b][/i]

We would welcome any feedback about the game and its integration on Steam, so please, don’t hesitate to leave us a comment on the [b]forums[/b] or in the [b]discussions section[/b]. If there are any specific issues that you experience, please get in touch and we will try our best to investigate it as quickly as possible.

notes.title: WAKFU AL HOWIN UPDATE - Free anime episode offered!
notes.notes:
[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/ankama/cms/images/273/2014/10/28/425694.jpg[/img]

[h1]Al Howin ingame event[/h1]
Starting from October 29, come and celebrate Al Howin in WAKFU! The City of Astrub is plunged in darkness: Take part in the exclusive quests and go through a hell of battles in the Witch’s Lair!

[b]Activities[/b]: During the event of Al Howin Gobball, Ghouls are invading Astrub. A short quest will allow you to unlock access to the exclusive Dungeon (available during the whole event). 

[b]Currency[/b]: Al Howin Tokens can be obtained in the environmental quests of Astrub, with the daily quests of Katrina Slevastan, and by beating the Boss of the Witch’s Lair.

[b]Rewards[/b]: Barter Al Howin tokens for decoration items, a costume and an exclusive accessory. You can get those items from the Token Machine in front of the Witch’s Lair. You can unlock 8 achievements, and earn Al Howin tokens and titles!

[h1]Free anime episode[/h1]
As a last treat for this special period, meet the terrible Count “Vampyro” in the WAKFU anime episode we’ve made available on the game page of WAKFU (trailer section). 

[h1]DLC Packs[/h1]
In addition and for a limited period, you can purchase one of the 2 new DLC packs we’ve released for the occasion: the Al Howin Pack and the Al Howin Freaking Pack. Get either of them and dress up in your Ghoul or Jack O’ costume to become the most stylish monster hunter of Al Howin!  Want to ride with class? No need to lose your head: Get the Al Howin Freaking Pack to mount your Skull-harnessed Dragon-Steed and start a hell-for-leather chase.  

http://store.steampowered.com/app/215080/

[*]Wabbit Dungeon
[*]Cuwsed Cawwot Stowewoom

To your Cawwots!

notes.title: Welcome to the WAKFU Steam Closed Beta
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Words cannot express how thrilled we are to have you here with us!
WAKFU now enters a new era as we begin its implementation on Steam; starting with this Closed Beta for which you will play an important part as our first users.

Now, before getting into it, if you don’t already have a Beta access, just visit [url=https://secure.wakfu.com/en/steam]this page[/url] to generate your key.
Note that the amount of keys is limited, so better not waste any time! We will keep adding new ones and will make sure to let you know when we do, so don’t hesitate to tell your friends about it! There might even be a little surprise at the end for those who joined us early…

We welcome any feedback about the game and its integration on Steam, so please, don’t hesitate to leave us a comment on the forums. Please also let us know if you experience any specific issue, and we will try our best to investigate it as quickly as possible.

Now go, and enjoy your stay in the World of Twelve!
